schemes.title: आयुष्मान भारत PM-JAY सेहत (गोल्डन कार्ड)
schemes.department: State Health Agency, Health & Medical Education Department, Jammu & Kashmir
schemes.brief: Free health cover of Rs.5 lakh a year for every family living in Jammu & Kashmir, whatever its income, including government employees and pensioners. Treatment is cashless at empanelled government and private hospitals in J&K, and at PM-JAY hospitals across India. The card, called the Golden Card or Ayushman card, is made on the family's ration card, and you can make it yourself on the phone.
schemes.benefit: Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, no premium
eligibility: Every family living in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir, with no income limit
The family must hold a J&K ration card; every member named on it is covered
Government employees, pensioners and their families are covered too
Families already in the PM-JAY list get the same Rs.5 lakh card under that list
Everyone aged 70 or above can also get the Ayushman Vay Vandana card
Illnesses you already have are covered from day one, with 3 days of costs before admission and 15 days after
documents: Aadhaar card of each family member
J&K ration card (inner and outer pages), which links the whole family
OTP के लिए मोबाइल नंबर
Domicile certificate, if the CSC or hospital desk asks for proof of residence
e-KYC ସମୟରେ ଫୋନରେ ନିଆଯାଇଥିବା ଲାଇଭ ଫଟୋ

demoFields.label: ଏହି ଭାବେ ଲଗଇନ
demoFields.hint: ନିଜ ପାଇଁ ବା ପରିବାର ପାଇଁ କାର୍ଡ ତିଆରି କରୁଥିଲେ ବେନିଫିସିଆରି (Beneficiary) ବାଛନ୍ତୁ, ଅପରେଟର (Operator) ନୁହେଁ।

demoFields.label: ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: Any working number you hold. The OTP comes here, and so does the message when the card is approved.

demoFields.label: ଯୋଜନା ଓ ରାଜ୍ୟ
demoFields.hint: SEHAT runs through PM-JAY, so choose PMJAY and then Jammu and Kashmir.

demoFields.label: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପରିବାରକୁ କେଉଁଥିରେ ଖୋଜିବେ
demoFields.hint: The ration card number finds everyone in the family at once. You can also search by Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: Copy it from the ration card. If nothing is found, search again with your Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: e-KYC ପାଇଁ ଆଧାର ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the family member whose card you are making now. Each member is done one at a time.

demoFields.label: e-KYC ପଦ୍ଧତି
demoFields.hint: Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar; otherwise choose face authentication and scan the face on the phone camera.

demoFields.label: ଲାଇଭ ଫଟୋ
demoFields.hint: Good light, face straight, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets the request rejected.

demoFields.label: ପରିବାର ମୁଖ୍ୟଙ୍କ ସହ ସମ୍ପର୍କ
demoFields.hint: ରାସନ କାର୍ଡରେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ନାମ ଥିବା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ସହ ଏହି ସଦସ୍ୟଙ୍କ କି ସମ୍ପର୍କ।

demoFields.label: ଜିଲ୍ଲା ଓ PIN କୋଡ
demoFields.hint: Where you actually live now, so the nearest empanelled hospitals are shown to you.

demoSteps: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in (or the Ayushman app) and log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP.
Choose PMJAY and the state Jammu and Kashmir, then search for your family by ration card number or Aadhaar.
Find the member marked eKYC pending, verify with Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, and take the live photo.
Fill in the relation, district and PIN code and submit. The State Health Agency usually approves it within a day or two.
Log in again, open Download Card and save the Golden Card. If your family is not found, go to a CSC or the Ayushman Mitra desk of a SEHAT hospital with your ration card and Aadhaar.
At the hospital, show the card at the Ayushman Mitra desk and pay nothing for a covered treatment. If an empanelled hospital refuses, call 104.
schemes.helpline: 104 — J&K health helpline, also for complaints when treatment is refused / 14555 or 1800-111-565 — Ayushman Bharat national helpline

schemes.title: e-UNNAT ଜମ୍ମୁ ଓ କାଶ୍ମୀର — ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଓ ସେବା
schemes.department: ସୂଚନା ପ୍ରଯୁକ୍ତି ବିଭାଗ, ଜମ୍ମୁ ଓ କାଶ୍ମୀର
schemes.brief: e-UNNAT ଜମ୍ମୁ ଓ କାଶ୍ମୀରର ପ୍ରାୟ ସବୁ ବିଭାଗର ସେବା ଗୋଟିଏ ଜାଗାକୁ ଆଣେ — ଡୋମିସାଇଲ, ଆୟ, ବର୍ଗ ଓ ଅନ୍ୟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ, ରାଜସ୍ୱ ସେବା, ଯୋଜନା ଆବେଦନ ଓ ବିଭାଗୀୟ ଅନୁମତି, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକର ପବ୍ଲିକ ସର୍ଭିସେସ ଗ୍ୟାରେଣ୍ଟି ଆଇନ ଅନୁସାରେ ଠିକ ହୋଇଥିବା ସମୟସୀମା ସହ।
schemes.benefit: ଡୋମିସାଇଲ, ଆୟ ଓ ବର୍ଗ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଏବଂ ବିଭାଗୀୟ ସେବା ଗୋଟିଏ ଜାଗାରେ
eligibility: ଜମ୍ମୁ ଓ କାଶ୍ମୀରର ବାସିନ୍ଦା, ପରିବାର ଯେଉଁ ତହସିଲରେ ରହେ ସେଠାରେ ଆବେଦନ କରିବେ
ଡୋମିସାଇଲ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟର ନିଜ ସର୍ତ୍ତ ଅଛି — କେନ୍ଦ୍ରଶାସିତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ କେତେ ବର୍ଷ ରହିଛନ୍ତି, ପଢ଼ିଛନ୍ତି ବା ଚାକିରି କରିଛନ୍ତି
ଜମ୍ମୁ ଓ କାଶ୍ମୀର ପାଇଁ ଘୋଷିତ ବର୍ଗଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ହିଁ ବର୍ଗ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଦିଆଯାଏ
ଆୟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଏକ ବର୍ଷ ପାଇଁ ବୈଧ
documents: ଆବେଦନକାରୀଙ୍କ ଆଧାର କାର୍ଡ
ପରିବାରର ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ

demoFields.label: ଦରକାରୀ ସେବା
demoFields.hint: ଡୋମିସାଇଲ, ଆୟ, ବର୍ଗ, ଚରିତ୍ର ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ବା କୌଣସି ରାଜସ୍ୱ ସେବା। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକର ନିଜ ଫର୍ମ, ଫି ଓ ସମୟସୀମା ଅଛି।

demoFields.label: ଆବେଦନକାରୀଙ୍କ ନାମ (ଆଧାରରେ ଯେପରି)
demoFields.hint: ଆଧାରରେ ଯେପରି ଅଛି ଅକ୍ଷରେ ଅକ୍ଷରେ ସେପରି। ଏହି ଲେଖାରୁ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଛପା ହୁଏ।

demoFields.label: ବାପା / ସ୍ୱାମୀଙ୍କ ନାମ
demoFields.hint: ଡୋମିସାଇଲ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ପାଇଁ ଏହା ସବୁଠୁ ଜରୁରୀ, କାରଣ ଦାବି ସାଧାରଣତଃ ବାପା ବା ମାଆଙ୍କ ବାସସ୍ଥାନ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରେ।

demoFields.label: ଆଧାର ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: ବାର ଅଙ୍କ। ଏହା ଦ୍ୱାରା ପରିଚୟ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ହୁଏ ଏବଂ OTP ଲିଙ୍କ ଥିବା ମୋବାଇଲକୁ ଆସେ।

demoFields.label: ଜିଲ୍ଲା / ତହସିଲ / ଗ୍ରାମ ବା ୱାର୍ଡ
demoFields.hint: ପରିବାର ଯେଉଁଠି ରହେ। ଏହି ତହସିଲର ତହସିଲଦାର ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟରେ ଦସ୍ତଖତ କରନ୍ତି।

demoFields.label: ଡୋମିସାଇଲ ଦାବିର ଭିତ୍ତି
demoFields.value: ବାପାଙ୍କ ପାଖରେ J&K ର ପର୍ମାନେଣ୍ଟ ରେସିଡେଣ୍ଟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଅଛି
demoFields.hint: ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ସମୟ ଧରି ବାସ, ବାପା ବା ମାଆଙ୍କ PRC, କେନ୍ଦ୍ରଶାସିତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ପଢ଼ା, କିମ୍ବା ସରକାରୀ ଚାକିରି। କେଉଁଟି ତାହା କୁହନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ତାହାର ପ୍ରମାଣ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ।

demoFields.label: ପରିବାରର ବାର୍ଷିକ ଆୟ (ଟ.)
demoFields.hint: ଆୟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ପାଇଁ, ସବୁ ଉତ୍ସରୁ ପରିବାରର ବର୍ଷକର ମୋଟ ଆୟ।

demoFields.label: ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ
demoFields.hint: ଫାଇଲ ପାଇଁ ଲେଖାଯାଏ। ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ କେଉଁଠି ବ୍ୟବହାର ହେବ ତାହା ଏହା ସୀମିତ କରେ ନାହିଁ।

demoFields.label: ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବର ଓ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହେବା ମେସେଜ SMSରେ ଏଠାକୁ ଆସେ।

demoSteps: eunnat.jk.gov.in ରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ମୋବାଇଲ ଦେଇ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର କରି OTP ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା କମନ ସର୍ଭିସ ସେଣ୍ଟରକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ, ଯେଉଁଠି ସରକାର ଠିକ କରିଥିବା ଫି ନେଇ ଫାଇଲ କରିଦିଅନ୍ତି।
ସେବା ବାଛି ଫର୍ମ ଭରନ୍ତୁ। ଡୋମିସାଇଲ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ପାଇଁ, କେଉଁ ଭିତ୍ତିରେ ଦାବି କରୁଛନ୍ତି ତାହା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ସେହି ଭିତ୍ତିର ପ୍ରମାଣ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ।
କାଗଜପତ୍ର ଅପଲୋଡ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଫି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବର ଲେଖି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
ପଟୱାରୀ ଓ ତହସିଲ କର୍ମଚାରୀ ପରିବାର ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତି। ଆପଣ ଦେଇଥିବା ମୋବାଇଲରେ ଫୋନ ଉଠାଇବାକୁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ରୁହନ୍ତୁ।
ତହସିଲଦାର ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟରେ ଦସ୍ତଖତ କରନ୍ତି ଏବଂ ସେହି ଲଗଇନରୁ ଏହା ଡାଉନଲୋଡ ହୁଏ।
ପବ୍ଲିକ ସର୍ଭିସେସ ଗ୍ୟାରେଣ୍ଟି ଆଇନ ଅନୁସାରେ ପ୍ରତି ସେବାର ସମୟସୀମା ଅଛି। ତାହା ପାର ହୋଇଗଲେ, ସେହି ଆଇନରେ ଆପଣ ଅପିଲ କରିପାରିବେ, ଏବଂ ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବର ହିଁ କହିବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ।
schemes.helpline: 0194-2506062 — e-UNNAT ହେଲ୍ପଡେସ୍କ, ଜମ୍ମୁ ଓ କାଶ୍ମୀର

schemes.title: लाडली बेटी योजना, जम्मू और कश्मीर
schemes.department: Department of Social Welfare, Jammu & Kashmir
schemes.brief: For a girl born on or after 1 April 2015 into a low-income family in Jammu & Kashmir, the government puts Rs.1,000 a month into an account in her name until she turns 14. The money then stays in a term deposit, and at 21 she receives about Rs.6.5 lakh for her studies or marriage. Parents apply online on JanSugam (also reached through e-UNNAT); the CDPO checks the application and the Deputy Commissioner sanctions it.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,000 a month till she is 14; about Rs.6.5 lakh paid to her at 21
eligibility: The girl was born on or after 1 April 2015
The parents' total income from all sources is below Rs.75,000 a year
The girl and her parents are residents of Jammu & Kashmir
The money is held in the girl's own account and paid to her only at age 21
documents: लड़की का जन्म प्रमाण पत्र
Income certificate of the parents, showing less than Rs.75,000 a year
Aadhaar card of the girl and of the parents
माता-पिता का निवास प्रमाण पत्र (Domicile certificate)
Ration card or other address proof
J&K Bank account details in the girl's name, once the sanction letter asks for them

demoFields.label: बेटी का नाम
demoFields.hint: Exactly as written on her birth certificate.

demoFields.label: ଜନ୍ମ ତାରିଖ
demoFields.hint: Must be on or after 01/04/2015. Apply soon after the birth certificate is issued.

demoFields.label: जन्म स्थान
demoFields.hint: The hospital or place named on the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: ବାପାଙ୍କ ନାମ
demoFields.hint: ତାଙ୍କ ଆଧାର କାର୍ଡରେ ଯେମିତି ଅଛି।

demoFields.label: ମାତାଙ୍କ ନାମ
demoFields.hint: उसके आधार कार्ड के अनुसार।

demoFields.label: माता-पिता का आधार नंबर
demoFields.hint: The 12 digits on the mother's or father's own Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: वार्षिक पारिवारिक आय (रु.)
demoFields.hint: Total from all sources, the same figure as on the income certificate. It must be below Rs.75,000.

demoFields.label: जिला और ICDS प्रोजेक्ट
demoFields.hint: The block ICDS project where you live. Its CDPO checks your form.

demoFields.label: ଠିକଣା
demoFields.hint: जहां परिवार अब रहता है।

demoFields.label: ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: Application updates and the sanction message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on jansugam.jk.gov.in (or open it from e-UNNAT) with your mobile number, then log in.
Under Social Welfare, choose Application for obtaining Financial Assistance under Ladli Beti Scheme and fill in the girl's and parents' details.
Upload the birth, income and domicile certificates and the Aadhaar cards, submit, and note the application number from the SMS.
The CDPO checks the form within 15 days, then the District Programme Officer and the Deputy Commissioner take it up; the whole process is meant to finish within 45 days.
After sanction, open the girl's account at J&K Bank if the sanction letter asks, and add the account number on the portal.
Rs.1,000 is credited every month until she turns 14. At 21 the matured amount, about Rs.6.5 lakh, is paid to her.
schemes.helpline: 0194-2479645 — Directorate of Social Welfare, Kashmir / your District Social Welfare Officer or CDPO (ICDS) office

schemes.title: अबुआ आवास योजना (अबुआ आवास)
schemes.department: Rural Development Department, Government of Jharkhand
schemes.brief: Jharkhand's own rural housing scheme: Rs.2 lakh to build a pucca house with three rooms and a kitchen, for families who have no house or live in a kutcha house and did not get one under PM Awas Yojana-Gramin. The state received about 30 lakh applications at the 'Aapki Yojana, Aapki Sarkar, Aapke Dwar' camps, found about 20 lakh genuine, and is building houses for them in phases. The money comes in instalments into the beneficiary's bank account as each stage of the house is geo-tagged, plus 95 days of MGNREGA wages for the family's own labour.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2 lakh in instalments for a 3-room pucca house with kitchen, plus 95 days of MGNREGA wages
eligibility: Rural families in Jharkhand with no house, or living in a kutcha or broken house
The family has never got a house under PMAY-G, Indira Awas, Birsa Awas or Baba Saheb Ambedkar Awas
Priority for PVTG families, families hit by natural disasters, and freed bonded labourers
Not for families with a serving or retired government employee, an income-tax or professional-tax payer, or a motorised four-wheeler or fishing boat
The family must be on the verified list made from the camp applications; each panchayat's list is shown at the Panchayat Bhawan
documents: ଆବେଦନକାରୀଙ୍କ ଆଧାର କାର୍ଡ
ପରିବାରର ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-linked account in the applicant's name
MGNREGA job card, for the 95 days of wages
Land paper for the plot where the house will be built (khatiyan or rent receipt)
जाति प्रमाण पत्र, यदि SC, ST या PVTG हैं
ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର
schemes.portalName: Abua Awas Yojana portal, Rural Development Department
schemes.submitAt: The 'Aapki Yojana, Aapki Sarkar, Aapke Dwar' camp in your panchayat when one is held, or the Panchayat Sachiv or the Block Development Officer (BDO) at the block office. Take Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook, MGNREGA job card and land papers. If you already applied at a camp, check your name in the list at the Panchayat Bhawan, because houses are sanctioned from that list in order. There is no fee, so never pay a middleman who promises a house.

demoFields.label: ଆବେଦନକାରୀଙ୍କ ନାମ
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The sanction and payments are in this name.

demoFields.label: पिता / पति का नाम
demoFields.hint: Husband's name if married, otherwise father's name.

demoFields.label: गांव, पंचायत, ब्लॉक, जिला
demoFields.value: Hesal, Hesal panchayat, Torpa block, Khunti district
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives and where the new house will be built.

demoFields.label: ଆଧାର ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: आवेदक का 12 अंकों का आधार नंबर।

demoFields.label: ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: परिवार का राशन कार्ड नंबर।

demoFields.label: सामाजिक श्रेणी
demoFields.hint: Write SC, ST, OBC or General, and say if the family belongs to a PVTG group.

demoFields.label: वर्तमान घर
demoFields.value: Kutcha, mud walls with tiled roof
demoFields.hint: Describe the house you live in now, or write 'no house'.

demoFields.label: House received earlier under PMAY-G, Indira Awas or Birsa Awas?
demoFields.hint: Answer truthfully. Families who already got a government house are left out.

demoFields.label: ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତା ନମ୍ବର ଓ IFSC
demoFields.hint: An Aadhaar-linked account in the applicant's own name. Every instalment comes here.

demoFields.label: मनरेगा जॉब कार्ड नंबर
demoFields.hint: Needed for the 95 days of wages for building your own house.

demoSteps: If you applied at a camp, look for your name on the Abua Awas list at the Panchayat Bhawan. If you never applied, apply at the next 'Aapki Yojana, Aapki Sarkar, Aapke Dwar' camp or at the block office.
Panchayat and block staff visit to check that your house is kutcha and that the family never got a government house.
Selected families get a sanction letter, and the first instalment comes to the bank account.
Build the house in stages. At each stage the staff geo-tag a photo of it on the Abua Awas app, and the next instalment is released after that.
Work on your own house as MGNREGA labour and get up to 95 days of wages in your account; ask the Rozgar Sevak to open the work on your job card.
Finish the house with three rooms and a kitchen. The final geo-tag closes the case. For delays or demands for money, go to the Panchayat Sachiv or the BDO.
schemes.helpline: No dedicated helpline. Contact your Panchayat Sachiv or Rozgar Sevak, then the Block Development Officer (BDO) at the block office

schemes.title: Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Maiya Samman Yojana (Maiyan Samman)
schemes.department: Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand
schemes.brief: Rs.2,500 a month for women aged 18 to 50 in Jharkhand, paid into their own Aadhaar-linked bank account by the 15th of every month. It started in August 2024 at Rs.1,000 and was raised to Rs.2,500 from December 2024. Applications are taken at camps held across the state; there is no online form to fill yourself. Women already getting the money must finish the physical verification (satyapan) and Aadhaar e-KYC, or the next instalments are held back.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,500 a month (Rs.30,000 a year) into the woman's own bank account
eligibility: Resident of Jharkhand, aged 18 or above and below 50 on the day of applying
Her family holds a yellow Antyodaya, pink Priority Household, white K-Oil or green state ration card
She has her own Aadhaar and a single bank account linked to Aadhaar

Not for a woman who, or whose husband (father, if she is unmarried), works for the central or state government, a PSU, local body or government-aided institution as regular, contract or honorarium staff, or draws a government pension
Not if a family member is a present or former MP or MLA, if the family pays income tax, or if she is an EPF member
Not if she already gets another social security pension from the department
documents: ଆଧାର କାର୍ଡ
Ration card of the family (yellow, pink, white or green)
Passbook of the Aadhaar-linked bank account in her own name
ఓటర్ ఐడీ కార్డ్
PAN card, if she has one (optional)
एक रंगीन पासपोर्ट साइज फोटो
ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର
Signed self-declaration, which is part of the form
schemes.submitAt: The Maiya Samman camp held in your panchayat or urban ward. The department takes applications through camps across Jharkhand, announced by the Anganwadi worker, Panchayat Sachiv and block office; between camps, ask at your Anganwadi centre or the block (Prakhand) or circle (Anchal) office. The form is free (the printed summary on the 2024 form still says Rs.1,000; the amount is now Rs.2,500). Go yourself, because your Aadhaar and photo are checked on the spot. Take the original Aadhaar, ration card, Aadhaar-linked bank passbook and voter ID, a colour photo and self-attested copies, and keep the acknowledgement.

demoFields.label: आवेदिका का नाम (Applicant's name)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on Aadhaar. The money goes only to this woman.

demoFields.label: पिता/पति का नाम (Father's / husband's name)
demoFields.hint: Husband's name if married, otherwise father's name.

demoFields.label: पता (Village/mohalla, police station, panchayat/ward, block/circle, district)
demoFields.value: Tetartoli, PS Kanke, Panchayat Sarwa, Block Kanke, District Ranchi
demoFields.hint: Your present address in Jharkhand, as on the ration card.

demoFields.label: आधार संख्या (Aadhaar number)
demoFields.hint: Her own 12-digit Aadhaar number, one digit per box.

demoFields.label: खाता संख्या (Bank account number)
demoFields.hint: Her own single account. A joint account or someone else's account will be rejected.

demoFields.label: खाता आधार लिंक्ड है (Is the account linked to Aadhaar?)
demoFields.hint: Payment is made only to an Aadhaar-linked account. Get it linked at the bank before the camp.

demoFields.label: बैंक का नाम (शाखा सहित) / IFSC Code
demoFields.value: Bank of India, Kanke branch / BKID0099999
demoFields.hint: Copy the bank name, branch and IFSC from the first page of the passbook.

demoFields.label: राशन कार्ड संख्या (Ration card number)
demoFields.hint: Her name should be on this yellow, pink, white or green card.

demoFields.label: आयु / जन्म तिथि (Age / date of birth)
demoFields.hint: She must be 18 or above and below 50. Use the date on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: आवेदिका का मोबाइल नंबर (Mobile number)
demoFields.hint: Payment and verification messages come to this number.

demoSteps: Find out the date of the Maiya Samman camp in your panchayat or ward from the Anganwadi worker, Panchayat Sachiv or block office, and get the free form there (or print the official form).
Fill the form, tick that the account is Aadhaar-linked, paste the photo, sign the declaration and attach self-attested copies of Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook and voter ID.
Go to the camp yourself. The operator enters the form on the portal and checks your Aadhaar and photo. Keep the acknowledgement.
Block and district officials verify the application. Once approved, Rs.2,500 arrives in your Aadhaar-linked account by the 15th of every month.
When the Anganwadi worker or block office calls you for satyapan or e-KYC, complete it. Names that are not verified do not get the next instalment.
If the money stops, check at the bank that the account is still linked to Aadhaar, then call 1800-890-0215 or complain at the block office.
schemes.helpline: 1800-890-0215 — toll-free, Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Jharkhand

schemes.title: Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana (SPKSY)
schemes.department: Directorate of Social Welfare, Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand
schemes.brief: Money for girls in Jharkhand to stay in school and not be married off early: Rs.2,500 in Class 8, Rs.2,500 in Class 9, Rs.5,000 each in Classes 10, 11 and 12, and a one-time Rs.20,000 at age 18 to 19, Rs.40,000 in all. It goes to the first two daughters of a mother who study in government or government-aided schools. For school girls the school applies, by sending the girl's details from e-Vidya Vahini to the scheme portal. Others apply with the official form at the CDPO office.
eligibility: Girls living in Jharkhand, enrolled in Class 8 to 12 in a government, government-aided, welfare-department or NCLP school
Only the first two daughters of a mother; the mother gives a self-declaration
Parents must not be permanent or retired central or state government or PSU employees, or draw a government pension or family pension
Parents must not pay income tax
For the Rs.20,000 grant she must be 18 or 19 years old when applying, and a voter ID is needed
documents: लड़की का आधार कार्ड
Aadhaar card of the mother (of the father, if the mother has died)
जन्म प्रमाण पत्र
Bank or post office passbook in the girl's name
ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ
वोटर ID कार्ड (18-19 साल की सहायता के लिए)
Mother's self-declaration on birth order, and the parents' self-declaration that they are not taxpayers or government employees
Principal's certificate that she studies in the school; for orphans, the parents' death certificate and a Child Welfare Committee certificate
schemes.portalName: Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana portal
schemes.submitAt: Girls in Class 8 to 12: ask the headmaster or class teacher. The school sends the girl's details from e-Vidya Vahini to the Savitribai portal, adds her Aadhaar, bank account and declarations, and forwards it to the CDPO. Girls of 18 to 19 who have left school, and anyone the school has not covered: fill the official form and hand it in at the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) office of your block, yourself or through your Anganwadi worker. Attach self-attested copies of the ration card, Aadhaar, voter ID and bank passbook, the self-declarations and the principal's certificate. Girls still in school at 18 to 19 can apply through the school.

demoFields.label: आवेदिका का नाम (Name of the girl)
demoFields.hint: As on her Aadhaar and school register.

demoFields.label: माता/पिता/अभिभावक का नाम (Mother's / father's / guardian's name)
demoFields.hint: The mother's name comes first. A guardian is written only for an orphan.

demoFields.label: ग्राम, पंचायत, प्रखंड, जिला (Village, panchayat, block, district)
demoFields.value: Barwadih, Barwadih panchayat, Chas block, Bokaro district
demoFields.hint: In a town, write the nagar nigam, nagar panchayat or nagar parishad instead of the block.

demoFields.label: आंगनवाड़ी केन्द्र का नाम एवं कोड (Anganwadi centre name and code)
demoFields.hint: Only if you know it. The Anganwadi worker can tell you.

demoFields.label: जन्म तिथि / जन्म प्रमाण पत्र संख्या (Date of birth / birth certificate number)
demoFields.hint: Attach a copy of the birth certificate. For the 18–19 grant, also give the voter ID number.

demoFields.label: आवेदिका का जन्म क्रम (Birth order)
demoFields.hint: Only the first or second daughter can apply. The mother signs a declaration on this.

demoFields.label: आवेदिका का आधार संख्या (Girl's Aadhaar number)
demoFields.hint: The girl's own 12-digit Aadhaar number.

demoFields.label: बैंक/पोस्ट ऑफिस खाता संख्या, शाखा, IFSC (Bank or post office account, branch, IFSC)
demoFields.hint: An account in the girl's own name. The money is sent here by DBT.

demoFields.label: विद्यालय का नाम, कक्षा, रोल नम्बर (School, class, roll number)
demoFields.value: Govt. High School Barwadih, Class 9, Roll 27
demoFields.hint: The principal signs a certificate that she studies in this class.

demoFields.label: लाभ प्राप्ति का वर्ग (Benefit category)
demoFields.hint: Tick the one class she is in now, or 18–19 years for the Rs.20,000 grant.

demoSteps: At the start of the school year, tell the class teacher that she wants the Savitribai benefit, and give copies of her Aadhaar, the mother's Aadhaar, the birth certificate, the bank passbook and the ration card.
The school sends her details from e-Vidya Vahini to the Savitribai portal, adds the Aadhaar, bank account and declarations, and forwards the application to the CDPO.

For the Rs.20,000 grant at 18 or 19 after leaving school, fill the official form, attach the self-declarations and voter ID, and submit it at the CDPO office or through the Anganwadi worker. Keep the receipt.
The CDPO checks the application and the District Social Welfare Officer approves it. Wrong details are sent back to the school for correction.
The money for that class comes by DBT into the girl's account. Check the status on savitribaipksy.jharkhand.gov.in under Track Beneficiary Status.
Repeat every year from Class 8 to Class 12, then apply for the Rs.20,000 grant at age 18 or 19.
schemes.helpline: 0651-2400757 / 0651-2223544 — Directorate of Social Welfare, Ranchi (technical help, savitribaihelpdesk@gmail.com) / 1800-890-0215 — department toll-free

schemes.title: ଇ-କଲ୍ୟାଣ ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡ — SC, ST, OBC ଓ ସଂଖ୍ୟାଲଘୁ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ସ୍କଲାରସିପ
schemes.department: ଅନୁସୂଚିତ ଜନଜାତି, ଅନୁସୂଚିତ ଜାତି, ସଂଖ୍ୟାଲଘୁ ଓ ପଛୁଆ ବର୍ଗ କଲ୍ୟାଣ ବିଭାଗ, ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡ ସରକାର
schemes.brief: ଇ-କଲ୍ୟାଣ ହେଉଛି ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡ କଲ୍ୟାଣ ବିଭାଗର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ସ୍କଲାରସିପ ପୋର୍ଟାଲ — ଏହା ନ୍ୟାସନାଲ ସ୍କଲାରସିପ ପୋର୍ଟାଲଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା। SC, ST, OBC ଓ ସଂଖ୍ୟାଲଘୁ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀ ଏଠାରେ ପ୍ରି-ମାଟ୍ରିକ (ଶ୍ରେଣୀ 1 ରୁ 10) ଓ ପୋଷ୍ଟ-ମାଟ୍ରିକ (କଲେଜ ଓ ତା' ଉପରେ) ସ୍କଲାରସିପ ପାଇଁ ଆବେଦନ କରନ୍ତି, ପ୍ରତି ବର୍ଷ ରିନ୍ୟୁ କରନ୍ତି ଓ ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତି। ପୋର୍ଟାଲ ଅନୁସାରେ 2024-25 ରେ 6 ଟି ଯୋଜନାରେ ଟ.1,339.35 କୋଟି ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଠିକଣା ହେଉଛି ekalyan.cgg.gov.in, jharkhand.gov.in ନାଁ ନୁହେଁ, କାରଣ ଏହି ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ସେଣ୍ଟର ଫର ଗୁଡ ଗଭର୍ନାନ୍ସ ଚଳାଏ।
schemes.benefit: ପ୍ରି-ମାଟ୍ରିକ ଓ ପୋଷ୍ଟ-ମାଟ୍ରିକ ସ୍କଲାରସିପ, DBT ଦ୍ୱାରା ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ନିଜ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତାକୁ
eligibility: ଛାତ୍ର/ଛାତ୍ରୀ ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡର ଅନୁସୂଚିତ ଜାତି, ଅନୁସୂଚିତ ଜନଜାତି, ପଛୁଆ ବର୍ଗ ବା ଘୋଷିତ ସଂଖ୍ୟାଲଘୁ ସମ୍ପ୍ରଦାୟର ହୋଇଥିବା ଦରକାର
ଛାତ୍ର/ଛାତ୍ରୀ ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡର ଡୋମିସାଇଲ ହୋଇଥିବା ଦରକାର — ସ୍କଲାରସିପ ନିଜ ରାଜ୍ୟରୁ ମିଳେ, କଲେଜ ଥିବା ରାଜ୍ୟରୁ ନୁହେଁ
ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର୍ଡ ଥିବା ସ୍ୱୀକୃତିପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ସ୍କୁଲ ବା ସଂସ୍ଥାରେ ପଢ଼ୁଥିବା ଦରକାର; ଆପଣଙ୍କ କଲେଜ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର୍ଡ ନ ଥିଲେ, ତାହା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଫର୍ମ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିପାରିବ ନାହିଁ
ପରିବାରର ଆୟ ସେହି ବର୍ଷ ପାଇଁ ସେହି ସ୍କଲାରସିପର ଘୋଷିତ ସୀମା ଭିତରେ ଥିବା ଦରକାର, ତେଣୁ ଫର୍ମ ଭରିବା ଆଗରୁ ପୋର୍ଟାଲର ନୋଟିସ ପଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ
ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତା ଛାତ୍ର/ଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ନିଜ ନାଁରେ ଓ ତାଙ୍କ ଆଧାର ସହ ସିଡେଡ ଥିବା ଦରକାର; ବାପାମାଆଙ୍କ ବା ଜଏଣ୍ଟ ଖାତା ନାକଚ ହୁଏ
ରିନ୍ୟୁଆଲ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରତି ବର୍ଷ ଆବେଦନ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ, ଏହା ନିଜେ ନିଜେ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ
documents: ଛାତ୍ର/ଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ଆଧାର କାର୍ଡ
ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡରେ ଜାରି ଜାତି ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ, କିମ୍ବା ସଂଖ୍ୟାଲଘୁ ଘୋଷଣାପତ୍ର
ବାପାମାଆ ବା ଅଭିଭାବକଙ୍କ ଆୟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ
ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡର ବାସସ୍ଥାନ (ଡୋମିସାଇଲ) ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ
ଶେଷ ପାସ କରିଥିବା ପରୀକ୍ଷାର ମାର୍କସିଟ
ଚଳିତ ବର୍ଷ ପାଇଁ ସଂସ୍ଥାର ଫି ରସିଦ ବା ଆଡମିଶନ ରସିଦ
ଖାତା ନମ୍ବର ଓ IFSC ଥିବା, ଛାତ୍ର/ଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ନିଜ ନାଁରେ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ପାସବୁକ
ପାସପୋର୍ଟ ସାଇଜ ଫଟୋ

demoFields.label: କେଉଁ ସ୍କଲାରସିପ ପାଇଁ ଆବେଦନ
demoFields.hint: ପ୍ରି-ମାଟ୍ରିକ ଶ୍ରେଣୀ 1 ରୁ 10 ପାଇଁ, ପୋଷ୍ଟ-ମାଟ୍ରିକ କଲେଜ ଓ ତା' ଉପରେ। ପ୍ରଥମ ବର୍ଷ ପାଇଁ ନୂଆ (ଫ୍ରେସ) ଓ ତା' ପରେ ରିନ୍ୟୁଆଲ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ।

demoFields.label: ଛାତ୍ର/ଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ନାମ (ଆଧାରରେ ଥିବା ପରି)
demoFields.hint: ଆଧାର ଓ ମାର୍କସିଟରେ ଯେମିତି ଅଛି ଅକ୍ଷରେ ଅକ୍ଷରେ ସେମିତି। ମେଳ ନ ଖାଇଲେ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ଅଟକିଯାଏ।

demoFields.label: ବାପା / ଅଭିଭାବକଙ୍କ ନାଁ
demoFields.hint: ଆପଣ ଅପଲୋଡ କରୁଥିବା ଆୟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟରେ ଥିବା ସେହି ନାଁ।

demoFields.label: ଜନ୍ମ ତାରିଖ
demoFields.hint: ଶ୍ରେଣୀ 10 ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟରେ ଯେମିତି ଛପା ହୋଇଛି।

demoFields.label: ବର୍ଗ
demoFields.hint: ଜାତି ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟରେ ଠିକ ଯେମିତି ଅଛି। ଯୋଜନା ଓ ଟଙ୍କା ହାର ଏହା ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରେ।

demoFields.label: ଆଧାର ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: ବାର ଅଙ୍କ। ସେହି ଆଧାର ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତାରେ ସିଡେଡ ଥିବା ଦରକାର, ନହେଲେ DBT ଟ୍ରାନ୍ସଫର ବିଫଳ ହୁଏ।

demoFields.label: ଜିଲ୍ଲା / ବ୍ଲକ
demoFields.hint: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ନିଜ ଜିଲ୍ଲା ଓ ବ୍ଲକ। ଏହି ଜିଲ୍ଲାର ଜିଲ୍ଲା କଲ୍ୟାଣ ଅଧିକାରୀ ସ୍କଲାରସିପ ମଞ୍ଜୁର କରନ୍ତି।

demoFields.label: ସଂସ୍ଥା, କୋର୍ସ ଓ ବର୍ଷ
demoFields.value: ପି.କେ. ରାୟ ମେମୋରିଆଲ କଲେଜ, ଧନବାଦ — B.A. (ଅନର୍ସ) ଇତିହାସ — 2ୟ ବର୍ଷ
demoFields.hint: ପୋର୍ଟାଲର ତାଲିକାରୁ ସଂସ୍ଥା ବାଛନ୍ତୁ। ତାଲିକାରେ ନ ଥିଲେ, କଲେଜକୁ ଆଗେ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର କରିବାକୁ କୁହନ୍ତୁ।

demoFields.label: ପରିବାରର ବାର୍ଷିକ ଆୟ (ଟ.)
demoFields.hint: ଆପଣ ଅପଲୋଡ କରୁଥିବା ଆୟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟରୁ ଅଙ୍କ ନକଲ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଦୁଇଟି ଏକା ଅଙ୍କ ହେବା ଦରକାର।

demoFields.label: ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତା ନମ୍ବର ଓ IFSC
demoFields.hint: ଛାତ୍ର/ଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ନିଜ ଖାତା। ପାସବୁକର ପ୍ରଥମ ପୃଷ୍ଠାରୁ ଦୁଇଟିଯାକ ଗୋଟି ଗୋଟି ଅଙ୍କ ମିଳାଇ ନକଲ କରନ୍ତୁ।

demoSteps: ବର୍ଷର ନୋଟିସ ପାଇଁ ekalyan.cgg.gov.in ଉପରେ ନଜର ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରି-ମାଟ୍ରିକ ଓ ପୋଷ୍ଟ-ମାଟ୍ରିକ ଅଲଗା ଅଲଗା ତାରିଖରେ ଖୋଲେ ଏବଂ ଶେଷ ତାରିଖ କଡ଼ା — ଡେରିରେ ଦିଆଯାଇଥିବା ଫର୍ମ ଗ୍ରହଣ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ।
ସବୁଠୁ ଆଗେ, ଛାତ୍ର/ଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ନିଜ ନାଁରେ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତା ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ବ୍ରାଞ୍ଚରେ ତାଙ୍କ ଆଧାର ସିଡିଂ କରାନ୍ତୁ। ପେମେଣ୍ଟ DBT ରେ ହୁଏ ଏବଂ ବାପାମାଆଙ୍କ ବା ଜଏଣ୍ଟ ଖାତା ନାକଚ ହୁଏ।
ଆପଣଙ୍କ ମୋବାଇଲ ଓ ଆଧାର ଦେଇ ଛାତ୍ର ଭାବେ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର କରନ୍ତୁ, ତା' ପରେ ଫର୍ମ ଭରନ୍ତୁ: ବର୍ଗ, ସଂସ୍ଥା, କୋର୍ସ, ବର୍ଷ, ଦେଇଥିବା ଫି ଓ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ବିବରଣୀ।
ଜାତି ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ, ଆୟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ, ବାସସ୍ଥାନ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ, ଶେଷ ମାର୍କସିଟ ଓ ଫି ରସିଦ ଅପଲୋଡ କରନ୍ତୁ। ସବମିଟ କରି ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବର ଲେଖି ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସଂସ୍ଥା ନିଜ ଲଗଇନରେ ଆବେଦନ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବା ଦରକାର। କଲେଜ ଅଫିସକୁ ଯାଇ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରନ୍ତୁ ଯେ ଏହା ଆଗକୁ ପଠାଯାଇଛି — ଅନ୍ୟ କୌଣସି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟଠାରୁ ଏହି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ହିଁ ଅଧିକ ଆବେଦନ ଅଟକିଯାଏ।
ଜିଲ୍ଲା କଲ୍ୟାଣ ଅଫିସ ମଞ୍ଜୁର କରେ ଏବଂ ଟଙ୍କା ସିଡେଡ ଖାତାରେ ଜମା ହୁଏ। ସେହି ଲଗଇନ ଦେଇ ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ସ୍ଥିତି ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।
ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଶିକ୍ଷା ବର୍ଷରେ ରିନ୍ୟୁଆଲ ପାଇଁ ପୁଣି ଆବେଦନ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଶେଷ ତାରିଖ ଛାଡ଼ିଗଲେ ରିନ୍ୟୁଆଲ ରଦ୍ଦ ହୋଇଯାଏ ଏବଂ ପରେ ଦାବି କରିହୁଏ ନାହିଁ।
schemes.helpline: ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ କୌଣସି ହେଲ୍ପଲାଇନ ନମ୍ବର ଦିଆଯାଇନାହିଁ। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଜିଲ୍ଲାର ଜିଲ୍ଲା କଲ୍ୟାଣ ଅଧିକାରୀ, କିମ୍ବା ଆପଣଙ୍କ କଲେଜର କଲ୍ୟାଣ ସେକ୍ସନ (ଯାହା ପାଖରେ ସଂସ୍ଥାର ଲଗଇନ ଥାଏ) ସହ ଯୋଗାଯୋଗ କରନ୍ତୁ।

schemes.title: ଝାରସେବା — ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡ ଇ-ଡିଷ୍ଟ୍ରିକ୍ଟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ
schemes.department: ସୂଚନା ପ୍ରଯୁକ୍ତି ଓ ଇ-ଗଭର୍ନାନ୍ସ ବିଭାଗ, ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡ ସରକାର
schemes.brief: ଝାରସେବା ହେଉଛି ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡର ଇ-ଡିଷ୍ଟ୍ରିକ୍ଟ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା। ଜାତି, ଆୟ ଓ ବାସସ୍ଥାନ (ଡୋମିସାଇଲ) ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ, ଜନ୍ମ ଓ ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ, ଜମି ରେକର୍ଡ ସେବା ଓ ସାମାଜିକ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପେନସନ ଆବେଦନ ବ୍ଲକ ଅଫିସ ବଦଳରେ ଏଠାରେ ଦିଆଯାଏ, ଏବଂ ଦସ୍ତଖତ ହୋଇଥିବା ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ସେହି ଲଗଇନରୁ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ ହୁଏ। ନିଜେ କରିପାରୁନଥିଲେ, ପ୍ରଜ୍ଞା କେନ୍ଦ୍ର (କମନ ସର୍ଭିସ ସେଣ୍ଟର) ସରକାର ଠିକ କରିଥିବା ଫି ନେଇ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଫାଇଲ କରିଦେବ।
schemes.benefit: ଜାତି, ଆୟ, ବାସସ୍ଥାନ, ଜନ୍ମ ଓ ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ପାଇଁ ଅନଲାଇନ ଆବେଦନ ଓ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ
eligibility: ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡର ବାସିନ୍ଦା, ପରିବାର ପ୍ରକୃତରେ ଯେଉଁ ବ୍ଲକ ଓ ସର୍କଲରେ ରହେ ସେଠାରେ ଆବେଦନ କରିବେ
ବାସସ୍ଥାନ (ଡୋମିସାଇଲ) ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ପାଇଁ ପରିବାର ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡରେ ରହୁଥିବାର ପ୍ରମାଣ ଦରକାର — ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ ଏବଂ ସେହି ଠିକଣାର ଜମି ବା ଭଡ଼ା ରେକର୍ଡ
ଜାତି ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ କେବଳ ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡର ନିଜ ତାଲିକାରେ ଥିବା ଜାତି ପାଇଁ ଦିଆଯାଏ, ଏବଂ ବାପାଙ୍କ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ସହ ମିଳାଇ ଯାଞ୍ଚ ହୁଏ
ଆୟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଆର୍ଥିକ ବର୍ଷର ପରିବାର ଆୟ ଲେଖାଥାଏ, ତେଣୁ ବିଭାଗଗୁଡ଼ିକ ନୂଆ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ମାଗନ୍ତି
ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଆଧାର ସହ ଲିଙ୍କ ଥିବା ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର ଚାଲୁ ଥିବା ଦରକାର, କାରଣ ପୁରା ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା OTP ଓ SMS ରେ ଚାଲେ
documents: ଆବେଦନକାରୀଙ୍କ ଆଧାର କାର୍ଡ
ପରିବାରର ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ
ଠିକଣା ପ୍ରମାଣ — ବିଜୁଳି ବିଲ, ହୋଲ୍ଡିଂ ଟ୍ୟାକ୍ସ ରସିଦ ବା ଭଡ଼ା ଚୁକ୍ତିନାମା
ଜାତି ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ପାଇଁ ବାପାଙ୍କ ଜାତି ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ
ଆୟ ପ୍ରମାଣ — ଦରମା ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ, କିମ୍ବା ଦରମା ନ ଥିଲେ ସ୍ୱ-ଘୋଷଣାପତ୍ର
ଜନ୍ମ ତାରିଖ ପାଇଁ ସ୍କୁଲ ଲିଭିଂ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ବା ଶ୍ରେଣୀ 10 ମାର୍କସିଟ
ଜମି ରେକର୍ଡ (ଖତିୟାନ ବା ଖଜଣା ରସିଦ), ଯଦି ଦାବି ପରିବାର ନାଁରେ ଥିବା ଜମି ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରେ
ପାସପୋର୍ଟ ସାଇଜ ଫଟୋ

demoFields.label: ଦରକାରୀ ସେବା
demoFields.hint: ଜାତି, ଆୟ, ବାସସ୍ଥାନ, ଜନ୍ମ, ମୃତ୍ୟୁ, ଜମି ରେକର୍ଡ ବା ପେନସନ। ପ୍ରତି ସେବାର ନିଜ ଫର୍ମ ଓ ନିଜ ପ୍ରମାଣ ତାଲିକା ଅଛି।

demoFields.label: ଆବେଦନକାରୀଙ୍କ ନାମ (ଆଧାରରେ ଯେପରି)
demoFields.hint: ଆଧାରରେ ଯେମିତି ଅଛି ଅକ୍ଷରେ ଅକ୍ଷରେ ସେମିତି। ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଠିକ ଏହି ବାକ୍ସରୁ ଛପା ହୁଏ।

demoFields.label: ବାପା / ସ୍ୱାମୀଙ୍କ ନାମ
demoFields.hint: ରାଜସ୍ୱ ଓ ଜାତି ରେକର୍ଡରେ ଏହି ନାଁ ଦେଇ ପରିବାର ଖୋଜାଯାଏ, ତେଣୁ ତାଙ୍କ ନିଜ କାଗଜରେ ଥିବା ବନାନ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

demoFields.label: ଜନ୍ମ ତାରିଖ
demoFields.hint: ଶ୍ରେଣୀ 10 ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ବା ଜନ୍ମ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟରେ ଯେମିତି ଅଛି, ମନେ ଥିବା ଅନୁସାରେ ନୁହେଁ।

demoFields.label: ଆଧାର ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: ବାର ଅଙ୍କ। ଏହା ଦ୍ୱାରା ପରିଚୟ ଯାଞ୍ଚ ହୁଏ ଏବଂ OTP ଏହା ସହ ଲିଙ୍କ ଥିବା ମୋବାଇଲକୁ ଆସେ।

demoFields.label: ଜିଲ୍ଲା / ବ୍ଲକ / ପଞ୍ଚାୟତ / ଗାଁ
demoFields.hint: ପରିବାର ଯେଉଁଠି ରହେ। ଏହି ସର୍କଲର ସର୍କଲ ଅଫିସର ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟରେ ଦସ୍ତଖତ କରନ୍ତି।

demoFields.label: ଜାତି ଓ ବର୍ଗ
demoFields.hint: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାପାଙ୍କ ଜାତି ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟରେ ଠିକ ଯେମିତି ଅଛି ସେମିତି ଜାତି ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ। ଅଫିସ ଏହାକୁ ରାଜ୍ୟର ଘୋଷିତ ତାଲିକା ସହ ମିଳାଏ।

demoFields.label: ପରିବାରର ବାର୍ଷିକ ଆୟ (ଟ.)
demoFields.hint: ପୁରା ପରିବାରର ବର୍ଷକର ଆୟ — ମଜୁରି, ଚାଷ, ଦୋକାନ, ଭଡ଼ା ଓ ପେନସନ ମିଶାଇ, କେବଳ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ନିଜର ନୁହେଁ।

demoFields.label: ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ
demoFields.hint: ଫାଇଲରେ ଲେଖାଯାଏ। ପରେ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ କେଉଁଠି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରିବେ ତାହା ଏହା ସୀମିତ କରେ ନାହିଁ।

demoFields.label: ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବର ଓ 'ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ' ମେସେଜ SMS ରେ ଏଠାକୁ ଆସେ।

demoSteps: jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in ରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ନାଁ, ମୋବାଇଲ ଓ ଇମେଲ ଦେଇ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର କରି OTP ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରନ୍ତୁ — କିମ୍ବା କାଗଜପତ୍ର ନେଇ ପ୍ରଜ୍ଞା କେନ୍ଦ୍ର ବା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବ୍ଲକ ଅଫିସକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ, ଯେଉଁଠି ସରକାର ଠିକ କରିଥିବା ଫି ନେଇ କାଉଣ୍ଟରରେ ଫାଇଲ କରିଦିଅନ୍ତି।
ସେବା ବାଛନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଆଧାର ଓ ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ ଦେଖି ଫର୍ମ ଭରନ୍ତୁ। ବ୍ଲକ ଓ ପଞ୍ଚାୟତ ଗୋଳମାଳ କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ; ଫାଇଲ ସେହି ଅନୁସାରେ ଆଗକୁ ଯାଏ।
ସ୍କାନ କପି ଅପଲୋଡ କରନ୍ତୁ, ସବମିଟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବର ଲେଖି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ପରେ ସବୁକିଛି କେବଳ ସେହି ନମ୍ବରରେ ଟ୍ରାକ ହୁଏ।
ସର୍କଲ ଅଫିସରଙ୍କ କର୍ମଚାରୀ ଦାବି ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତି। ଜାତି ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ପାଇଁ ଯାଞ୍ଚ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାପାଙ୍କ ରେକର୍ଡ ଦେଇ ହୁଏ, ତେଣୁ ତାଙ୍କ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ହାତ ପାଖରେ ରଖନ୍ତୁ।
ମଞ୍ଜୁର ହେଲେ, ସେହି ଲଗଇନରୁ ଡିଜିଟାଲ ଦସ୍ତଖତ ଥିବା ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଡିଜିଟାଲ ଦସ୍ତଖତ ଥିବା କପି ପାଇଁ ଆଉ କୌଣସି ଆଟେଷ୍ଟେସନ ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ।
ଝାଡ଼ଖଣ୍ଡର ସେବା ଗ୍ୟାରେଣ୍ଟି ଆଇନ ଏହି ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ପାଇଁ ସମୟସୀମା ଠିକ କରିଛି। ତାହା ପାର ହୋଇଗଲେ, ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବର ନେଇ ସର୍କଲ ଅଫିସରଙ୍କୁ, ତା' ପରେ ଡେପୁଟି କମିଶନରଙ୍କ ଅଫିସରେ କୁହନ୍ତୁ।
schemes.helpline: ଝାରସେବା ପାଇଁ କୌଣସି ହେଲ୍ପଲାଇନ ନମ୍ବର ଦିଆଯାଇନାହିଁ। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବ୍ଲକ ଅଫିସ (ପ୍ରଖଣ୍ଡ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାଳୟ) ବା ନିକଟତମ ପ୍ରଜ୍ଞା କେନ୍ଦ୍ରରେ ପଚାରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ ଟେକ୍ନିକାଲ ସମସ୍ୟା ପାଇଁ ଜିଲ୍ଲା ଇନଫର୍ମାଟିକ୍ସ ଅଫିସରେ ପଚାରନ୍ତୁ।

schemes.title: Ayushman Bharat – Arogya Karnataka (AB-ArK Health Card)
schemes.department: Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Karnataka — Suvarna Arogya Suraksha Trust (SAST)
schemes.brief: Karnataka's health cover, run together with the central Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. Families with a BPL (Priority Household or Antyodaya) ration card get free treatment up to Rs.5 lakh a year for the whole family; other families get 30% of the treatment cost paid, up to Rs.1.5 lakh a year. Treatment starts at a government hospital, which refers you to a listed private hospital if it cannot treat you; listed emergencies can go straight to a listed hospital. The card is made at a government hospital counter for Rs.10 with your Aadhaar and ration card.
schemes.benefit: BPL families: up to Rs.5 lakh a year free; other families: 30% of the cost, up to Rs.1.5 lakh a year
eligibility: Every resident of Karnataka with an Aadhaar card can enrol
Eligible category (free treatment up to Rs.5 lakh per family per year): families with a Priority Household (BPL) or Antyodaya ration card under the Food Security Act
General category (APL card or no ration card): the government pays 30% of the package rate, up to Rs.1.5 lakh per family per year, and the family pays the rest
Simpler treatments are given only in government hospitals. A private hospital needs a referral from a government hospital, except for the listed emergencies
Aadhaar authentication is compulsory before a referral to a private hospital
documents: Aadhaar card of the patient (each member of the family enrols separately)
Ration card, which decides whether you are in the eligible or the general category
Mobile number, for the SMS with your ArK ID
Rs.10 for the card (Rs.20 for a reprint if it is lost)
Referral letter from the government hospital, when going to a private hospital
Earlier prescriptions, test reports and discharge papers, if any
schemes.submitAt: At the registration (Arogya Mitra) counter of any government hospital: Primary Health Centre, Community Health Centre, taluk or district hospital, or medical college hospital. Take every member's Aadhaar card and the ration card, and Rs.10 per card. Grama One, Karnataka One and Bangalore One centres also issue the card.

demoFields.label: ଆଧାର ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: The patient's own Aadhaar. Each family member is enrolled one by one.

demoFields.label: Authentication
demoFields.hint: Fingerprint on the biometric device. If it fails, the staff can use an OTP to the Aadhaar mobile or the QR code on the Aadhaar card.

demoFields.label: Ration card (PDS) number
demoFields.hint: From the ration card. It links you to your family in the food department's records.

demoFields.label: ବର୍ଗ
demoFields.hint: Filled automatically: Priority Household or Antyodaya card = Eligible; APL card or no card = General.

demoFields.label: Name, gender and age
demoFields.hint: Taken from the Aadhaar e-KYC. Check the spelling before the card is printed.

demoFields.label: ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: SMS के जरिए आपकी ArK ID यहीं भेजी जाती है।

demoFields.label: District / Taluk
demoFields.hint: जहां आप रहते हैं।

demoFields.label: Consent and self-declaration
demoFields.value: Signed — no other health insurance scheme
demoFields.hint: A printed form: you allow your Aadhaar to be used for enrolment and state that you are not covered by another scheme.

demoFields.label: ArK ID (generated)
demoFields.hint: Your ration card number, a dash and your member number. It is printed on the card.

demoFields.label: Card fee
demoFields.hint: Paid once. A reprint of a lost card costs Rs.20.

demoSteps: Go to the registration counter of a government hospital (PHC, CHC, taluk or district hospital) with your Aadhaar and ration card.
The staff check your Aadhaar by fingerprint (or OTP or QR code), and your ration card decides your category: Eligible (BPL) or General.
Sign the consent and self-declaration, pay Rs.10, and collect the printed card with your ArK ID. Repeat this for each family member.
When you fall ill, go first to a government hospital. If it cannot give the treatment, ask the doctor for a referral to a private hospital empanelled under AB-ArK.
At the private hospital, go to the Arogya Mitra desk with the card, your Aadhaar and the referral letter. The hospital takes approval from SAST; for eligible families the treatment is cashless.
In an emergency covered by the listed emergency procedures, go straight to the nearest empanelled hospital. No referral is needed.
If a hospital asks a BPL card holder to pay for a covered treatment, call 104 or 1800 425 8330 before paying.
schemes.helpline: 104 — Arogya Sahayavani (toll free); 1800 425 8330 — Arogya Karnataka helpline

schemes.title: Karnataka Social Security Pensions (Old Age, Sandhya Suraksha, Widow and Disability Pension)
schemes.department: Directorate of Social Security and Pensions, Revenue Department, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Karnataka pays a monthly pension to poor elderly people, widows and people with disabilities, straight into a bank or post office account. The old age pension is Rs.600 a month from 60 to 64 and Rs.1,200 from 65; Sandhya Suraksha gives Rs.1,200 to farmers, labourers, weavers and fishermen aged 65 and above; widows get Rs.800; people with disabilities get Rs.800 to Rs.2,000. One common form covers all of them, and you hand it in at the Atalji Janasnehi Kendra (Nadakacheri) for your area.
schemes.benefit: Rs.600 to Rs.2,000 a month depending on the pension; Rs.1,200 for most people aged 65 and above
eligibility: Resident of Karnataka, with a family income below Rs.32,000 a year
Old age pension (IGNOAPS): BPL, aged 60 or above. Rs.600 a month at 60 to 64, Rs.1,200 at 65 and above

Sandhya Suraksha: aged 65 or above; small or marginal farmer, farm labourer, weaver, fisherman or unorganised worker (not construction-board workers); husband and wife's deposits together not above Rs.10,000. Rs.1,200 a month
Widow pension: destitute widow aged 18 to 64. Rs.800 a month, until remarriage or a job that takes income above the limit
Disability pension: 40% disability or more, certified by a medical board, Rs.800; 75% or more, Rs.1,400; 75% or more mental disability, Rs.2,000
Not already drawing another pension. Having sons does not disqualify you if they do not support you
documents: भरा हुआ आवेदन फॉर्म
ଆଧାର କାର୍ଡ
Age proof: birth certificate, voter ID with date of birth, or a doctor's age certificate
निवास प्रमाण पत्र
आय प्रमाण पत्र (रु. 32,000 प्रति वर्ष से कम)
Bank or post office passbook, first page
ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ
As needed: husband's death certificate (widow), medical board disability certificate (disability), occupation certificate from the Tahsildar (Sandhya Suraksha)
schemes.submitAt: The Atalji Janasnehi Kendra (Nadakacheri counter) at your hobli or taluk office. Take the filled form, signed or with your thumb impression, with copies of Aadhaar, age proof, residence and income certificates, the bank or post office passbook and the ration card, plus the death, disability or occupation certificate your pension needs. The counter charges a small service fee; ask for the printed acknowledgement.

demoFields.label: ଜିଲ୍ଲା / ତାଲୁକ / ହୋବଳି / ଗାଁ
demoFields.hint: Written at the top of the form. It decides which village officer verifies your application.

demoFields.label: ଆବେଦନକାରୀଙ୍କ ନାମ
demoFields.hint: आपके आधार के अनुसार।

demoFields.label: Male or female
demoFields.hint: टिक करें या एक लिखें।

demoFields.label: ପିତା ବା ସ୍ୱାମୀଙ୍କ ନାମ
demoFields.hint: Husband's name for a married woman or a widow, father's name otherwise.

demoFields.label: Full postal address (present and permanent)
demoFields.value: Door no. 7, Hosahalli, Sira taluk, Tumakuru 572137
demoFields.hint: Write both if you live away from your permanent home.

demoFields.label: Age on the date of application
demoFields.hint: Write which age proof you are attaching.

demoFields.label: Pension applied for
demoFields.hint: Tick one box: old age, widow, disability, Sandhya Suraksha, Manaswini, Maithri, acid attack victim, farmer's widow or endosulfan victim.

demoFields.label: Family's annual income
demoFields.hint: Must be below Rs.32,000. Attach the income certificate.

demoFields.label: Combined deposits of husband and wife
demoFields.value: Rs.4,500, savings account, Sira branch of a co-operative bank
demoFields.hint: Amount, type of deposit and the bank. For Sandhya Suraksha it must not be above Rs.10,000.

demoFields.value: No other pension; farm labourer (Tahsildar's certificate attached)
demoFields.hint: Another pension makes you ineligible. The occupation certificate is needed for Sandhya Suraksha.

demoSteps: Download the common pension form from dssp.karnataka.gov.in, or ask for it at the Nadakacheri counter.
Fill it in, tick the pension you want, sign or put your left thumb impression, and attach the documents.
Hand it in at the Atalji Janasnehi Kendra for your hobli or taluk, and keep the acknowledgement number.
The village administrative officer and the revenue inspector check your age, income and residence, often with a home visit. The Tahsildar then sanctions the pension.
The pension order gives you a beneficiary ID. The pension is then paid every month into your bank or post office account.

Check the status, or a stopped payment, on the Beneficiary Status page of dssp.karnataka.gov.in with your beneficiary ID. If payments stop, first make sure your account is seeded with Aadhaar, then go to the taluk office.
schemes.helpline: 080-22232040 / 080-22232012 — Directorate of Social Security and Pensions, Bengaluru; 1902 — Karnataka government citizen helpline

schemes.title: Shakti Yojana (Free Bus Travel for Women)
schemes.department: Transport Department, Government of Karnataka — KSRTC, BMTC, KKRTC and NWKRTC
schemes.brief: Women and girls who live in Karnataka, and transgender persons, travel free in ordinary government buses anywhere inside the state. There is no form, card or registration: show a government photo ID with a Karnataka address to the conductor and you get a zero-fare Shakti ticket. Air-conditioned and luxury buses, sleeper buses and buses that cross into another state are not free.
schemes.benefit: Free travel in ordinary and express non-AC government buses within Karnataka
eligibility: Women and girls of any age who live in Karnataka, including school and college students
Transgender persons who live in Karnataka
No income, caste or age limit, and nothing to apply for
Covers ordinary and express non-AC buses of KSRTC, BMTC, KKRTC and NWKRTC, including non-AC electric buses
Not covered: Rajahamsa, AC buses such as Airavat, Vajra, Vayu Vajra, Ambaari and Flybus, sleeper buses, and interstate routes, even for the Karnataka part of the trip
documents: आधार कार्ड, या
Voter ID, driving licence, passport, or MGNREGA job card with photo and address
Photo ID with address issued by a Government of India or Karnataka department or a public sector company
ID card from the Department for the Empowerment of Differently Abled and Senior Citizens, or a transgender ID card
School or college ID card, for girl students
The original, a photocopy, or the DigiLocker copy (printed or on the phone) is accepted
schemes.submitAt: There is no form and nowhere to apply. Board an ordinary or express non-AC bus of KSRTC, BMTC, KKRTC or NWKRTC on a route inside Karnataka, show the conductor an ID with your photo and Karnataka address (original, photocopy or DigiLocker copy), and ask for the Shakti ticket.

demoFields.label: Corporation
demoFields.hint: Printed at the top of the ticket. KSRTC, BMTC, KKRTC and NWKRTC buses are all covered.

demoFields.label: Type of bus
demoFields.hint: Ordinary, express and non-AC electric buses are free. Rajahamsa, AC, sleeper and Flybus services are not.

demoFields.label: Boarding point
demoFields.hint: Tell the conductor where you got on.

demoFields.label: Destination
demoFields.hint: Must be inside Karnataka. On a bus going to another state you pay the full fare.

demoFields.label: ID shown
demoFields.hint: Any government photo ID that shows a Karnataka address.

demoFields.label: Passengers
demoFields.hint: Each woman and girl gets her own zero ticket. Men travelling with you buy normal tickets.

demoFields.label: Ticket type
demoFields.hint: Keep it until you get down. Checking staff can ask for it.

demoFields.label: किराया मूल्य मुद्रित
demoFields.hint: The ticket shows what the trip would have cost. The state pays this amount to the bus company.

demoSteps: Carry one ID with your photo and Karnataka address. Aadhaar is the easiest; a photocopy or the DigiLocker copy on your phone is also accepted.
Board an ordinary or express non-AC government bus. Check the name on the front: Rajahamsa, Airavat, Vajra, Vayu Vajra, Ambaari, Flybus and sleeper buses are not free.
Tell the conductor your destination, show the ID and ask for the Shakti ticket.
Take the zero-fare ticket and keep it until you get down. A passenger without a ticket can be fined even on a free trip.
On KSRTC, KKRTC and NWKRTC buses half the seats are kept for men; BMTC city buses have no such split.
If a conductor refuses the free ticket on a covered bus, note the bus number, route and time, and complain to that corporation's helpline.
schemes.helpline: KSRTC call centre (24x7): 080-26252625; BMTC helpline: 080-22483777; 1902 — Karnataka guarantee schemes helpline

schemes.title: ଭୂମି — କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକ RTC (ପହଣି) ଓ ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ
schemes.department: ରାଜସ୍ୱ ବିଭାଗ, କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକ ସରକାର
schemes.brief: ଭୂମିରେ କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକର ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଚାଷ ଜମିର ରେକର୍ଡ ଅଛି। RTC, ଯାହାକୁ ପହଣି ମଧ୍ୟ କୁହାଯାଏ, ଦେଖାଏ ଜମି କାହା ନାଁରେ, କେତେ, ଏବଂ କ'ଣ ଚାଷ ହୋଇଥିଲା। i-RTC ହେଉଛି ଡିଜିଟାଲ ଦସ୍ତଖତ ଥିବା କପି ଯାହା ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଓ ଅଫିସ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରନ୍ତି, ଏବଂ ବିକ୍ରି ବା ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ପରେ ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ (ନାମାନ୍ତରଣ) ସ୍ଥିତି ସେହି ସାଇଟରେ ଟ୍ରାକ ହୁଏ।
schemes.benefit: ଅନଲାଇନ RTC ଓ ଡିଜିଟାଲ ଦସ୍ତଖତ ଥିବା i-RTC, ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ ସ୍ଥିତି ଓ ସର୍ଭେ ନକ୍ସା ସହ
eligibility: କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକରେ ଥିବା ଓ ଅଧିକାର ରେକର୍ଡରେ ଲେଖାଥିବା ଚାଷ ଜମି
ଯେକେହି RTC ଦେଖିପାରିବେ; କେବଳ ମାଲିକ ବା ଆଇନଗତ ଉତ୍ତରାଧିକାରୀ ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ ପାଇଁ ଆବେଦନ କରିପାରିବେ
ବିକ୍ରି ପରେ ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ ପାଇଁ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର୍ଡ ଦଲିଲ ଦରକାର; ଉତ୍ତରାଧିକାର ପାଇଁ ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଓ ଉତ୍ତରାଧିକାରୀ କାଗଜ ଦରକାର
i-RTC ପାଇଁ ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର ଦରକାର, କାରଣ ଏହା OTP ଦେଇ ମିଳେ
documents: ସର୍ଭେ ନମ୍ବର ଓ ହିସ୍ସା ନମ୍ବର, କିମ୍ବା ମାଲିକଙ୍କ ନାଁ
i-RTC ବା ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ ପାଇଁ ଆଧାର କାର୍ଡ
କିଣା ଜମିର ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ ପାଇଁ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର୍ଡ ବିକ୍ରି ଦଲିଲ
ଉତ୍ତରାଧିକାର ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ ପାଇଁ ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଓ ବଂଶାବଳୀ
ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନର RTC ବା ପହଣି କପି

demoFields.label: ଦରକାରୀ ସେବା
demoFields.hint: ନିଜ ଜାଣିବା ପାଇଁ ମାଗଣା RTC ଦେଖିବା, ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ବା ଅଫିସ ପାଇଁ i-RTC, ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ ସ୍ଥିତି, କିମ୍ବା ମୋଜିନି ସର୍ଭେ ନକ୍ସା।

demoFields.label: ଜିଲ୍ଲା / ତାଲୁକ / ହୋବଳି / ଗାଁ
demoFields.hint: ତାଲିକାରୁ ଚାରିଟିଯାକ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ। ରେକର୍ଡ ଗାଁ ଅନୁସାରେ ରଖାଯାଏ।

demoFields.label: ସର୍ଭେ ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: ପୁରୁଣା RTC ବା କିଣା ଦଲିଲରୁ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

demoFields.label: ସର୍ନୋକ / ହିସ୍ସା ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: ସର୍ଭେ ନମ୍ବରର ଉପ-ବିଭାଗ। ଠିକ ଯେମିତି ଅଛି ସେମିତି ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ — ଭୁଲ ହିସ୍ସା ଦେଲେ ପଡ଼ୋଶୀଙ୍କ ଜମି ବାହାରିଯାଏ।

demoFields.label: ରେକର୍ଡରେ ଥିବା ମାଲିକଙ୍କ ନାଁ
demoFields.hint: ଜମି ରେକର୍ଡରେ ଥିବା ବନାନରେ, ଯାହା ଆଧାରଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା ହୋଇପାରେ। ଆଗେ ରେକର୍ଡର ବନାନରେ ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଦରକାର ହେଲେ ପରେ ସୁଧାରନ୍ତୁ।

demoFields.label: ବର୍ଷ / ଅବଧି
demoFields.hint: RTC ବର୍ଷ ଅନୁସାରେ ରଖାଯାଏ। କୌଣସି ଅଫିସ ପୁରୁଣାଟି ମାଗିନଥିଲେ ଚଳିତ ବର୍ଷର ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

demoFields.label: ଆଧାର ଓ ମୋବାଇଲ (i-RTC ପାଇଁ)
demoFields.hint: ଡିଜିଟାଲ ଦସ୍ତଖତ ଥିବା କପି ପାଇଁ ଦରକାର। ଡାଉନଲୋଡ ଲିଙ୍କ OTP ସହ ଏହି ମୋବାଇଲକୁ ଆସେ।

demoFields.label: ସ୍ଥିତି ଦେଖିବା ପାଇଁ ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ (MR) ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ ଫାଇଲ ବେଳେ ଦିଆଯାଏ। ଅଫିସ ଯିବା ବଦଳରେ ଏହା ଦେଇ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ଟ୍ରାକ କରନ୍ତୁ।

demoSteps: landrecords.karnataka.gov.in ଖୋଲି ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସର୍ଭେ ଓ ହିସ୍ସା ନମ୍ବରର RTC ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ। କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ, ମାଲିକଙ୍କ ନାଁ ଓ ଫସଲ ଏଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ଆପଣ ଜାଣିଥିବା ସହ ମିଳାନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ଦେଖିବା ମାଗଣା।
ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ, କୋର୍ଟ ବା ସବସିଡି ଦାବି ପାଇଁ i-RTC କିଣନ୍ତୁ — ଡିଜିଟାଲ ଦସ୍ତଖତ ଥିବା କପି। ସେଥିପାଇଁ ମାଗଣା ପ୍ରିଣ୍ଟ ଗ୍ରହଣ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ।
କିଣିବା ବା ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ପରେ, ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର୍ଡ ଦଲିଲ, କିମ୍ବା ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଓ ବଂଶାବଳୀ ସହ ତାଲୁକ ଅଫିସରେ ବା ନାଡକଚେରି ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ ଫାଇଲ କରନ୍ତୁ।
MR ନମ୍ବର ରଖନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଅଫିସରେ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରିବା ବଦଳରେ ଭୂମିରେ ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ଟ୍ରାକ କରନ୍ତୁ।
ତହସିଲଦାର ଆଦେଶ ଦେବା ଆଗରୁ ରେଭେନ୍ୟୁ ଇନସପେକ୍ଟର ନୋଟିସ ଦିଅନ୍ତି ଓ କୌଣସି ଆପତ୍ତି ଥିଲେ ଶୁଣନ୍ତି।
ଆଦେଶ ହୋଇଗଲେ, ନୂଆ RTC କାଢ଼ି ନାଁ ଓ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରଫଳ ଠିକ ଅଛି କି ନାହିଁ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏଠାରେ ଭୁଲ ଏବେ ସୁଧାରିବା ବର୍ଷ ବର୍ଷ ପରେ ସୁଧାରିବାଠାରୁ ବହୁତ ସହଜ।
ଆପଣଙ୍କ କାଗଜପତ୍ର ସହ ଚଳିତ RTC ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଫସଲ ଋଣ, PM-Kisan ଓ ରାଜ୍ୟର ଚାଷ ଯୋଜନା ସବୁଥିରେ ଏହା ମାଗନ୍ତି।

schemes.brief: କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକର ସବୁ ରାଜ୍ୟ ସ୍କଲାରସିପ ପାଇଁ ଗୋଟିଏ ପୋର୍ଟାଲ — ସ୍କୁଲ ପିଲାଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରି-ମାଟ୍ରିକ ଏବଂ କଲେଜରେ ପଢ଼ୁଥିବା SC, ST, OBC, କ୍ୟାଟେଗୋରି-1 ଓ ସଂଖ୍ୟାଲଘୁ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ପୋଷ୍ଟ-ମାଟ୍ରିକ। ପ୍ରତି ବର୍ଷ ନୂଆ କରି ଆବେଦନ କରାଯାଏ ଏବଂ ଟଙ୍କା DBT ଦ୍ୱାରା ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ନିଜ ଖାତାକୁ ଦିଆଯାଏ।

demoFields.label: ଜାତି ଓ ଆୟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ନମ୍ବର (ସିନ୍ଧୁତ୍ୱ ପ୍ରମାଣ ପତ୍ର)
demoFields.hint: କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକ ଜାତି-ସହ-ଆୟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟର RD ନମ୍ବର। ପୋର୍ଟାଲ ଏହାକୁ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରେ, ତେଣୁ ମିଆଦ ପୂରିଯାଇଥିବା ବା ଭୁଲ ଟାଇପ ହୋଇଥିବା ନମ୍ବର ଆବେଦନକୁ ଅଟକାଇଦିଏ।

demoFields.hint: ପୋର୍ଟାଲର ତାଲିକାରୁ ସଂସ୍ଥା ବାଛନ୍ତୁ। ତାଲିକାରେ ନ ଥିଲେ, ସଂସ୍ଥା SSP ରେ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର କରିନାହିଁ ଏବଂ ଆଗେ ତାହା କରିବା ଦରକାର।

demoFields.label: ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବର ଓ ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ମେସେଜ ଏଠାକୁ ଆସେ।

demoSteps: ଆଗେ ସେବା ସିନ୍ଧୁରୁ ସିନ୍ଧୁତ୍ୱ ପ୍ରମାଣ ପତ୍ର — କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକର ଜାତି-ସହ-ଆୟ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ — ଆଣନ୍ତୁ। SSP ଏହାର RD ନମ୍ବର ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରେ ଏବଂ ଚଳିତ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ବିନା ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼େ ନାହିଁ।
ssp.karnataka.gov.in ରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଆଧାର ଦେଇ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର କରନ୍ତୁ, e-KYC ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରି-ମାଟ୍ରିକ ବା ପୋଷ୍ଟ-ମାଟ୍ରିକ, ନୂଆ ବା ରିନ୍ୟୁଆଲ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ।
ପୋର୍ଟାଲର ତାଲିକାରୁ ସଂସ୍ଥା ଓ କୋର୍ସ ଭରନ୍ତୁ, ମାର୍କସ କାର୍ଡ, ବୋନାଫାଇଡ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଓ ଫି ରସିଦ ଅପଲୋଡ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ନିଜ ନାଁରେ ଆଧାର-ସିଡେଡ ଖାତା ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
ସବମିଟ କରି ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବର ଲେଖି ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ତା' ପରେ ସଂସ୍ଥା ସହ ଯୋଗାଯୋଗ ରଖନ୍ତୁ — ସଂସ୍ଥା ଆବେଦନ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରି ଆଗକୁ ନ ପଠାଇବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ କିଛି ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ।
କଲ୍ୟାଣ ବିଭାଗ ମଞ୍ଜୁର କରେ ଏବଂ ଟଙ୍କା DBT ଦ୍ୱାରା ଜମା ହୁଏ। ପୋର୍ଟାଲ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବରରେ ମଞ୍ଜୁରି ଓ ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ଦେଖାଏ।
ପ୍ରତି ବର୍ଷ ଚଳିତ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ସହ ପୁଣି ଆବେଦନ କରନ୍ତୁ। ରିନ୍ୟୁଆଲ ନିଜେ ନିଜେ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ ଏବଂ ସମୟ ଛାଡ଼ିଗଲେ ସେହି ବର୍ଷର ଟଙ୍କା ମିଳେ ନାହିଁ।

demoSteps: ବିଜ୍ଞପ୍ତି ପାଇଁ kpsc.kar.nic.in ଦେଖୁଥାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ସବୁଠୁ ଆଗରୁ ବୟସ, ଯୋଗ୍ୟତା ଓ ଭାଷା ସର୍ତ୍ତ ପଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ।
kpsconline.karnataka.gov.in ରେ SSLC ମାର୍କସିଟରେ ଯେପରି ଅଛି ଠିକ ସେପରି ନାମ ଓ ଜନ୍ମ ତାରିଖ ଦେଇ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଫଟୋ ଓ ଦସ୍ତଖତ କୁହାଯାଇଥିବା ସାଇଜରେ ଅପଲୋଡ କରନ୍ତୁ।
ଆବେଦନ ଫର୍ମ ପୂରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ, କେବଳ ସେହି କୋଟା ଦାବି କରନ୍ତୁ ଯାହାର ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପାଖରେ ଅଛି, ପରୀକ୍ଷା କେନ୍ଦ୍ର ବାଛନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଅନଲାଇନରେ ଫି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
ଆୟୋଗ ସଂଶୋଧନ ୱିଣ୍ଡୋ ଖୋଲିଲେ ତାହାର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ। ଭୁଲ ଏଣ୍ଟ୍ରି ସୁଧାରିବାର ଏହା ଏକମାତ୍ର ସୁଯୋଗ ଏବଂ ଏହା ଶୀଘ୍ର ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଯାଏ।
ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟର ପ୍ରାୟ ଏକ ସପ୍ତାହ ଆଗରୁ ଆଡମିଟ କାର୍ଡ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଫଟୋ ପରିଚୟପତ୍ର ସହିତ ନେଇଯାଆନ୍ତୁ।
KAS ରେ ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ପରୀକ୍ଷା, ମୁଖ୍ୟ ପରୀକ୍ଷା ଓ ଇଣ୍ଟରଭ୍ୟୁ ହୁଏ। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକର ଫଳାଫଳ ଆୟୋଗର ୱେବସାଇଟରେ ପ୍ରକାଶିତ ହୁଏ।
ଶେଷରେ ଡକ୍ୟୁମେଣ୍ଟ ଯାଞ୍ଚ ହୁଏ। ଆପଣ ଦାବି କରିଥିବା ସବୁ କାଗଜପତ୍ରର ମୂଳ କପି ଦେଖାନ୍ତୁ — ସେଠାରେ ଗ୍ରାମୀଣ କିମ୍ବା କନ୍ନଡ଼ ମାଧ୍ୟମ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଦେଖାଇ ନପାରିଲେ ଆପଣ ପଦବୀ ହରାଇବେ।

schemes.title: Karnataka Construction Workers Labour Card (KBOCWWB e-Card)
schemes.department: Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Construction workers in Karnataka who register with the Welfare Board get a labour card, now a digital e-card, which opens the board's help: Rs.50,000 for each of a woman worker's first two deliveries, Rs.60,000 for a marriage, up to Rs.2 lakh for a major illness, education help for children, accident cover and a pension at 60. You register on the board's Karmika Seva Kendra (KSK) portal with your Aadhaar mobile number and a 90-day work certificate. Workers who already hold an old Seva Sindhu or e-Karmika card move it to the new portal with their registration and reference numbers.
schemes.benefit: Labour e-card for board help: Rs.50,000 per delivery, Rs.60,000 for marriage, up to Rs.2 lakh medical aid, pension up to Rs.3,000 a month at 60
eligibility: आयु 18 से 60 वर्ष
Worked at least 90 days as a building or construction worker in the last 12 months: mason, helper, carpenter, painter, plumber, electrician, bar bender, tile layer and similar work
कर्नाटक में काम कर रहे हैं
The e-card is valid for one year. Renew it on the portal with a fresh work certificate, or the benefits stop
For the pension, you must have been registered for at least 3 years before turning 60
documents: Aadhaar card, and the mobile number linked to it
90-day work certificate in the board's format, signed by your employer or contractor, a registered construction workers' union, or the labour inspector
Ration card number and a copy of the card
Bank passbook of the worker and of the nominee (account number and IFSC)
Nominee's details, and the nominee's own application number if the nominee is also a construction worker
Educational certificate, only if you studied beyond SSLC
Ayushman Bharat card number, if you have one
Your old Seva Sindhu or e-Karmika card, if you already have one

demoFields.hint: The nominee receives the death and funeral help. Add your children too; education and marriage help is given for them.

demoFields.hint: Aadhaar-seeded accounts. Upload the passbook page for each.

demoFields.hint: Upload a copy of the card as well.

demoFields.hint: Name of the employer, the company, and the mobile number of the person in charge of the site.

demoFields.hint: Where you did the 90 days of work.

demoFields.value: Mason — certificate by a registered construction workers' union
demoFields.hint: Upload the 90-day certificate and the self-declaration. The labour inspector checks them, sometimes at the site.

demoSteps: Get the 90-day work certificate in the board's format (the KSK portal has the template), signed by your employer or contractor, a registered construction workers' union, or the labour inspector.

Open kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in, choose Apply for Registration, select 'Register as a New Construction Worker' and verify your Aadhaar-linked mobile with the OTP. Without a smartphone, go to the Karmika Seva Kendra or labour inspector's office in your taluk.
Fill in your personal, family, nominee, bank and work details as in this sample, and upload the documents (JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 2 MB each).
Submit and note the acknowledgement number. The labour inspector checks your documents and may visit the work site.
Once approved, download your e-card (digital labour ID) from your KSK dashboard.
Apply for help (delivery, marriage, medical, pension) from the same dashboard. For your children's education help, apply on the State Scholarship Portal, ssp.karnataka.gov.in.
Renew before the e-card expires: log in, and enter your current employer, work site and a new work certificate. The portal reminds you 15 days before expiry.

schemes.title: Yuva Nidhi (Unemployment Allowance for Graduates and Diploma Holders)
schemes.department: Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood Department (Department of Employment and Training), Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Karnataka pays a monthly allowance to young people who finished a degree or diploma and still have no job six months after the result: Rs.3,000 a month for graduates and postgraduates, Rs.1,500 for diploma holders. It is paid for up to two years, or until you get a job or start further studies, whichever comes first. You apply on Seva Sindhu (now Seva One), and you must confirm on the portal every three months that you are still unemployed, or the payment stops.
schemes.benefit: Rs.3,000 a month for graduates, Rs.1,500 a month for diploma holders, for up to 2 years
eligibility: Passed a degree, postgraduate degree or diploma from the 2022-23 academic year onward
No job (government or private) and not self-employed for 180 days after the result
Karnataka domicile: studied in Karnataka for at least 6 years, counting SSLC, PUC and the degree or diploma
Not studying further, not drawing an apprenticeship stipend, and not getting any other unemployment allowance
A bank account in your own name, seeded with Aadhaar
documents: Aadhaar card, with the mobile number linked to it for the OTP
Degree, postgraduate or diploma marks cards and the provisional or final certificate
SSLC and PUC marks cards, as proof of study in Karnataka
Bank passbook of an account in your own name, Aadhaar-seeded
मोबाइल नंबर और ईमेल आईडी
Self-declaration that you are not employed or studying (made on the portal)

demoSteps: Wait until 180 days have passed since your result date, with no job and no further studies.

Open the Yuva Nidhi service on Seva One (sevaone.karnataka.gov.in), log in or register with your mobile number and OTP, and complete the Aadhaar e-KYC. A Grama One, Karnataka One or Bangalore One centre can do this for you.
Fill in your qualification, register number, year of passing and SSLC and PUC details, upload the marks cards, and give your Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
Submit and note the application number. The district employment officer checks your certificates; follow it with 'Yuvanidhi Application Status Check' on the portal.
Once approved, the allowance is paid into your account every month by DBT. The department may also ask you to register on the Kaushalkar skills portal for training.
Every three months, submit the 'Unemployment Self Declaration' on the portal. If you miss it, the payment stops until you submit it.
When you get a job or join a course, stop declaring. The allowance ends after two years in any case.

schemes.title: କାବେରୀ ଅନଲାଇନ ସେବା — ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରେସନ, EC ଓ ବିବାହ
schemes.department: ଷ୍ଟାମ୍ପ ଓ ପଞ୍ଜୀକରଣ ବିଭାଗ, କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକ ସରକାର
schemes.brief: କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକରେ ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରେସନ କାବେରୀରେ ହୁଏ। ଆପଣ ଡାଟା ଏଣ୍ଟ୍ରି କରନ୍ତି ଓ ଷ୍ଟାମ୍ପ ଡ୍ୟୁଟି ଅନଲାଇନରେ ଦିଅନ୍ତି, ତା'ପରେ ସବ-ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରାର ଅଫିସରେ ଥରେ ଆପଏଣ୍ଟମେଣ୍ଟରେ ଯାଆନ୍ତି। ଏନକମ୍ବ୍ରାନ୍ସ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ (EC), ଦଲିଲର ସାର୍ଟିଫାଏଡ କପି ଓ ବିବାହ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରେସନ ମଧ୍ୟ ସେହି ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ ଅଛି।
schemes.benefit: ବୁକ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ସ୍ଲଟ ସହିତ ଅନଲାଇନ ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରେସନ, ସହିତ EC, ସାର୍ଟିଫାଏଡ କପି ଓ ବିବାହ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରେସନ

demoSteps: kaveri.karnataka.gov.in ରେ ମୋବାଇଲ ଓ ଇମେଲ ଦେଇ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଦରକାରୀ ସେବା ବାଛନ୍ତୁ।
EC ପାଇଁ ଜିଲ୍ଲା, ସବ-ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରାର ଅଫିସ, ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି ବିବରଣୀ ଓ ଅବଧି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ, ଅନଲାଇନରେ ଫି ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହେଲେ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ କରନ୍ତୁ।
ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରେସନ ପାଇଁ ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ ଡାଟା ଏଣ୍ଟ୍ରି କରନ୍ତୁ, କାଲକୁଲେଟରରେ ଷ୍ଟାମ୍ପ ଡ୍ୟୁଟି ଓ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରେସନ ଫି ହିସାବ କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଅନଲାଇନରେ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ ସବ-ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରାର ଆପଏଣ୍ଟମେଣ୍ଟ ସ୍ଲଟ ବୁକ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ଦିନସାରା ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରିବାରୁ ବଞ୍ଚାଏ — ସ୍ଲଟ ଏକ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ସମୟ, ଧାଡ଼ି ଟୋକନ ନୁହେଁ।
ସେହି ଦିନ ଦୁଇ ପକ୍ଷ, ଦୁଇଜଣ ସାକ୍ଷୀ ଓ ସବୁ କାଗଜପତ୍ରର ମୂଳ କପି ସହିତ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ। ସେଠାରେ ଫଟୋ ଓ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠି ଛାପ ନିଆଯାଏ।
ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରି ହୋଇଥିବା ଦଲିଲ ସ୍କାନ କରି ଫେରାଇ ଦିଆଯାଏ, ଏବଂ ପରେ ପୋର୍ଟାଲରୁ ସାର୍ଟିଫାଏଡ କପି ଡାଉନଲୋଡ କରିହେବ।
କିଛି ସପ୍ତାହ ପରେ ନୂଆ EC ବାହାର କରି ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ ଯେ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରେସନ ସେଥିରେ ଦେଖାଉଛି କି ନାହିଁ। ରେକର୍ଡ ପ୍ରକୃତରେ ଅପଡେଟ ହୋଇଛି ବୋଲି ଏହା ହିଁ ପ୍ରମାଣ।

schemes.brief: ବିଭିନ୍ନ ବିଭାଗର ଶହ ଶହ ସେବା ପାଇଁ କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକର ସିଙ୍ଗଲ ୱିଣ୍ଡୋ: ରାଜସ୍ୱ ବିଭାଗରୁ ଜାତି, ଆୟ ଓ ବାସସ୍ଥାନ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ, ପରିବହନ, ଶ୍ରମିକ କଲ୍ୟାଣ, ସାମାଜିକ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ଓ ଯୋଜନା ରେଜିଷ୍ଟ୍ରେସନ। କନ୍ନଡ଼ ଓ ଇଂରାଜୀରେ। ଆପଣ ମୋବାଇଲ OTP ଦେଇ ନିଜେ ଆବେଦନ କରିପାରିବେ, କିମ୍ବା ବାଙ୍ଗାଲୋର ୱାନ, କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକ ୱାନ ବା ଗ୍ରାମ ୱାନ କାଉଣ୍ଟର, କିମ୍ବା ତାଲୁକ ଅଫିସରେ ଥିବା ଅଟଳଜୀ ଜନସ୍ନେହୀ କେନ୍ଦ୍ରକୁ ଯାଇ ଆବେଦନ କରାଇପାରିବେ। ସକାଳ ଆଇନ ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସେବା ପାଇଁ ସମୟସୀମା ଧାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ, ଏବଂ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ରସିଦରେ ଏକ ସକାଳ ନମ୍ବର ଥାଏ ଯାହା ଦେଇ ଆପଣ ଅଭିଯୋଗ କରିପାରିବେ।

demoFields.hint: ଗତ ଆର୍ଥିକ ବର୍ଷରେ ସବୁ ଉତ୍ସରୁ ପରିବାରର ମୋଟ ରୋଜଗାର।

demoFields.label: ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: OTP, ସକାଳ ରସିଦ ନମ୍ବର ଓ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ ଲିଙ୍କ ସବୁ ଏଠାକୁ ଆସେ।

demoFields.label: ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଖାତା ନମ୍ବର ଓ IFSC
demoFields.hint: କେବଳ ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ଟଙ୍କା ଦେଉଥିବା ସେବା ପାଇଁ। ଆଧାର ସହିତ ଯୋଡ଼ା ଥିବା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ନିଜ ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

demoSteps: କେଉଁ ସେବା ଦରକାର ଓ ସେଥିପାଇଁ କ'ଣ ମାଗେ ତାହା ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ। ସେବା ସିନ୍ଧୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ଆଗରୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସେବାର ନିଜ ପୃଷ୍ଠାରେ କାଗଜପତ୍ର ତାଲିକା ଦେଖାଏ।
ଆଧାର ଓ ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର ଦେଇ ସେବା ସିନ୍ଧୁରେ ରେଜିଷ୍ଟର କରନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ OTP ଦେଇ e-KYC ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କରନ୍ତୁ।
ବିଭାଗ ଓ ସେବା ବାଛନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଏହି ନମୁନା ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ଫର୍ମ ପୂରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ।
କାଗଜପତ୍ର ଅପଲୋଡ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଫି ଲାଗୁ ହେଲେ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ଅନେକ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ପାଇଁ କେବଳ ଅଳ୍ପ ସରକାରୀ ଫି ଲାଗେ।
ସବମିଟ କରି ରସିଦ ସେଭ କରନ୍ତୁ। ସେଥିରେ ସକାଳ ନମ୍ବର ଏବଂ ଅଫିସ କେଉଁ ତାରିଖ ସୁଦ୍ଧା ଉତ୍ତର ଦେବ ତାହା ଥାଏ।
ଫୋନରେ ଏହା କରିବାକୁ ନ ଚାହିଁଲେ, ସେହି କାଗଜପତ୍ର ନେଇ ବାଙ୍ଗାଲୋର ୱାନ, କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକ ୱାନ ବା ଗ୍ରାମ ୱାନ କାଉଣ୍ଟର, କିମ୍ବା ତାଲୁକ ଅଫିସର ଅଟଳଜୀ ଜନସ୍ନେହୀ କେନ୍ଦ୍ରକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ, ଅପରେଟର ଆପଣଙ୍କ ନାମରେ ଆବେଦନ କରିଦେବେ।
ରେଭେନ୍ୟୁ ଇନସପେକ୍ଟର ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତି ଏବଂ ତହସିଲଦାର ଡିଜିଟାଲ ଦସ୍ତଖତ କରନ୍ତି। ରସିଦ ନମ୍ବର ଦେଇ ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ ସ୍ଥିତି ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।
ଦସ୍ତଖତ ହୋଇଥିବା ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଲଗଇନରୁ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ କରନ୍ତୁ। ସକାଳ ସମୟସୀମା ପାର ହୋଇଗଲେ ସକାଳ ନମ୍ବର ଦେଇ ଅଭିଯୋଗ କରନ୍ତୁ; ବିଳମ୍ବ ପାଇଁ ଆଇନରେ କ୍ଷତିପୂରଣର ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ଅଛି।
schemes.helpline: 1902 (ସକାଳ ନାଗରିକ ହେଲ୍ପଲାଇନ)

schemes.title: Gruha Jyothi (Free Electricity up to 200 Units)
schemes.department: Energy Department, Government of Karnataka, through the electricity supply companies (BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM, GESCOM)
schemes.brief: Karnataka gives every household free electricity up to its usual monthly use, as long as that stays within 200 units. Your free limit is your average monthly use in 2022-23 plus 10 units. Use within that limit and the bill is zero; use more and you pay only for the extra units; cross 200 units in a month and you pay the full bill for that month. You register once, free, by linking the house's electricity account to your Aadhaar. Owners and tenants can both apply.
schemes.benefit: Zero bill up to your free limit (average 2022-23 use + 10 units), up to 200 units a month
eligibility: A domestic (house) electricity connection in Karnataka. Shops and other commercial use are not covered
Owner, tenant or family member living in the house. One connection per Aadhaar, and one connection per house
Monthly use must stay at or below 200 units. Above 200, the full bill is charged for that month
Free limit = average monthly use in 2022-23 plus 10 units. A new house or new connection with no 2022-23 record gets a fixed limit based on the state average of 53 units
Old unpaid electricity dues must be cleared. Homes on Bhagya Jyothi, Kutira Jyothi and Amrut Jyothi are included in Gruha Jyothi
documents: Aadhaar card of the person applying
Latest electricity bill, for the ESCOM name and the Account ID (connection ID)
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar, for the OTP
The bill need not be in your name: tenants and family members choose their type in the form
Tenants: a rent agreement or other proof of living at that address, if the office asks for it

demoFields.label: पसंदीदा भाषा
demoFields.hint: English or Kannada. The labels of the form change to the language you pick.

demoFields.label: ESCOM नाम
demoFields.hint: The company named at the top of your bill: BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM, GESCOM or Hukkeri Society.

demoFields.label: खाता ID
demoFields.hint: The account or connection ID printed on your bill, not the meter number. The name and address then fill in from the ESCOM's records.

demoFields.label: ESCOM में खाता धारक का नाम
demoFields.hint: Comes from the ESCOM record. It may be the landlord's name or a late parent's name; that is fine.

demoFields.label: ESCOM में खाता धारक का पता
demoFields.hint: Filled in automatically. Check that it is the house you actually live in.

demoFields.label: उपयोगकर्ता प्रकार
demoFields.hint: Owner, Tenant, or Family member (for example, when the bill is in your father's name).

demoFields.label: ଆଧାର ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: Your own Aadhaar. One Aadhaar can be linked to only one connection in the whole state.

demoFields.label: ଆବେଦନକାରୀଙ୍କ ନାମ
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on your Aadhaar. The OTP check matches it.

demoFields.label: संचार के लिए फोन नंबर
demoFields.hint: The acknowledgement and later messages about the scheme come here.

demoFields.label: ଘୋଷଣା
demoFields.hint: You confirm the connection is used only for the house. Commercial use cancels the benefit, and the free amount is recovered with interest.

demoSteps: Keep your latest electricity bill ready and find the ESCOM name and the Account ID on it.

Open sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in, choose Gruha Jyothi and click to register. The form opens without any login. A Grama One, Karnataka One or Bangalore One centre, or your ESCOM office, will also register you free.
Select your ESCOM, type the Account ID and check the name and address that appear. Choose Owner, Tenant or Family member, then enter your Aadhaar and verify it with the OTP.
Tick the declaration, submit, and note the acknowledgement number. You can check the status later on the Seva Sindhu 'Track Status' page.
From the next bill, your bill shows your free limit (eligible units). Within it the bill is zero; above it you pay only for the extra units; above 200 units you pay the whole bill.
Tenants moving house: use the Gruha Jyothi De-link option on the same portal to free your Aadhaar from the old connection, then register again at the new house.
If the bill is not zero, first check the eligible-units line on it, then call 1912 or visit the ESCOM sub-division office with your acknowledgement number.
schemes.helpline: 1912 — ESCOM electricity helpline (24x7); 1902 — Karnataka guarantee schemes helpline; 080-22279954 / 87926 62814 — guarantee scheme application help

schemes.title: କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକ ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ — ଆହାର
schemes.department: ଖାଦ୍ୟ, ସାଧାରଣ ଯୋଗାଣ ଓ ଖାଉଟି ବ୍ୟାପାର ବିଭାଗ, କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକ ସରକାର
schemes.brief: ଆହାର ହେଉଛି କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକର ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା। ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ପରିବାର (Priority Household) କିମ୍ବା ଅନ୍ତ୍ୟୋଦୟ କାର୍ଡରେ ଅନ୍ନ ଭାଗ୍ୟ ଅଧୀନରେ ନ୍ୟାଯ୍ୟ ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଦୋକାନରୁ ମାଗଣା ଚାଉଳ ମିଳେ, ଏବଂ ଗୃହ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ମୀ, ଗୃହ ଜ୍ୟୋତି ଓ ଅନ୍ୟ ରାଜ୍ୟ ଯୋଜନାର ଟଙ୍କା ଏହି କାର୍ଡର ପରିବାର ରେକର୍ଡ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ଦିଆଯାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଏହାକୁ ଠିକ ରଖିବା ଜରୁରୀ।
schemes.benefit: ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ପରିବାର କିମ୍ବା ଅନ୍ତ୍ୟୋଦୟ କାର୍ଡ, ଅନ୍ନ ଭାଗ୍ୟ ଅଧୀନରେ ମାଗଣା ଚାଉଳ ସହିତ
eligibility: ପରିବାର କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକରେ ରହୁଥିବା ଏବଂ ଭାରତର ଅନ୍ୟ କୌଣସି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ ନଥିବା
ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ପରିବାର କାର୍ଡ ପାଇଁ ଆୟ, ଜମି, ଗାଡ଼ି ମାଲିକାନା ଓ ସରକାରୀ ଚାକିରି ଉପରେ ରାଜ୍ୟର ସୀମା ଭିତରେ ଥିବା ପରିବାର
ଘରର 18 ବର୍ଷ ବା ଅଧିକ ବୟସର ଜଣେ ମହିଳାଙ୍କୁ ପରିବାର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଭାବେ ଲେଖାଯାଏ
ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସଦସ୍ୟଙ୍କ ଆଧାର ଯୋଡ଼ା ଓ ବାୟୋମେଟ୍ରିକ e-KYC ହୋଇଥିବା ଦରକାର, ନହେଲେ ସେହି ସଦସ୍ୟଙ୍କ ଚାଉଳ ମିଳେ ନାହିଁ
documents: ପରିବାରର ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସଦସ୍ୟଙ୍କ ଆଧାର କାର୍ଡ
ଠିକଣା ପ୍ରମାଣ — ବିଜୁଳି ବିଲ, ଘର କର ରସିଦ ବା ଭଡ଼ା ଚୁକ୍ତିନାମା
କୌଣସି ସଦସ୍ୟ ଅନ୍ୟ ଜାଗାରୁ ଆସିଥିଲେ, ପୁରୁଣା କାର୍ଡରୁ ନାଁ କଟା (ଡିଲିସନ) ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ
ନବଜାତ ଶିଶୁ ପାଇଁ ଜନ୍ମ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ, କିମ୍ବା ନୂଆ ବୋହୂ ଯୋଡ଼ିବା ପାଇଁ ବିବାହ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ
ଗ୍ୟାସ କନେକ୍ସନ ନମ୍ବର
ପରିବାର ମୁଖ୍ୟଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ପାସବୁକ

demoFields.label: ଆବେଦନର ପ୍ରକାର
demoFields.hint: ନୂଆ କାର୍ଡ, ସଦସ୍ୟ ଯୋଡ଼ିବା, ସଦସ୍ୟ ହଟାଇବା, ବିବରଣୀ ସୁଧାରିବା, କିମ୍ବା ପରିବାର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ବଦଳାଇବା। ଠିକଟି ବାଛନ୍ତୁ ନହେଲେ ଫାଇଲ ଫେରିଆସିବ।

demoFields.label: ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ ନମ୍ବର
demoFields.hint: କାର୍ଡର ଆଗ ପାଖରୁ। କେବଳ ଏକଦମ ନୂଆ କାର୍ଡ ପାଇଁ ଖାଲି ଛାଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

demoFields.label: ପରିବାର ମୁଖ୍ୟ
demoFields.hint: ପରିବାରର 18 ବର୍ଷ କିମ୍ବା ତା'ଠୁ ଅଧିକ ବୟସର ଜଣେ ମହିଳା। ଏଠାରେ ଯାହାଙ୍କ ନାମ ଥାଏ ଗୃହ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ମୀ ଟଙ୍କା ତାଙ୍କୁ ମିଳେ, ତେଣୁ ଠିକ ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ।

demoFields.label: ମୁଖ୍ୟଙ୍କ ଆଧାର
demoFields.hint: ବାର ଅଙ୍କ। ପରିବାରର ସମସ୍ତ ହକ ଏହା ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ହିସାବ ହୁଏ।

demoFields.label: ଯୋଡ଼ାଯିବା ସଦସ୍ୟ, ସମ୍ପର୍କ ଓ ଆଧାର
demoFields.hint: ସେହି ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ନିଜ ଆଧାରରେ ଥିବା ନାମ, ଏବଂ ମୁଖ୍ୟଙ୍କ ସହିତ ତାଙ୍କ ସମ୍ପର୍କ।

demoFields.label: କାରଣ ଓ ସହାୟକ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ
demoFields.hint: ନବଜାତ ଶିଶୁ ପାଇଁ ଜନ୍ମ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଓ ଆଧାର ଦରକାର। ନୂଆ ବୋହୂ ପାଇଁ ବିବାହ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଓ ତାଙ୍କ ବାପଘର କାର୍ଡର ଡିଲିସନ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଦରକାର।

demoFields.label: ଜିଲ୍ଲା / ତାଲୁକ / ଗ୍ରାମ ବା ୱାର୍ଡ
demoFields.hint: ପରିବାର ଯେଉଁଠି ରହେ। ଏହି ଠିକଣାରୁ ନ୍ୟାଯ୍ୟ ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଦୋକାନ ଦିଆଯାଏ।

demoFields.label: ପରିବାରର ବାର୍ଷିକ ଆୟ (ଟ.)
demoFields.hint: ବର୍ଷରେ ପରିବାରର ମୋଟ ଆୟ। କାର୍ଡ ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ପରିବାର ହେବ ନା APL ତାହା ଏଥିରୁ ସ୍ଥିର ହୁଏ।

demoSteps: ahara.karnataka.gov.in ଖୋଲି ଦରକାରୀ ସେବା ବାଛନ୍ତୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଗ୍ରାମ ୱାନ ବା କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକ ୱାନ କେନ୍ଦ୍ରକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ, ଯେଉଁଠି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ଫି ନେଇ ଆବେଦନ କରିଦିଆଯାଏ।
ଗୋଟିଏ ଚୁଲିରୁ ଖାଉଥିବା ସବୁ ସଦସ୍ୟଙ୍କ ନାମ ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକଙ୍କ ସଠିକ ଆଧାର ସହିତ। ଚାଉଳ ନାମ ପିଛା ଗଣାଯାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଜଣେ ସଦସ୍ୟ ଛାଡ଼ିଗଲେ ପରିବାର ପ୍ରତି ମାସରେ କ୍ଷତି ସହେ।
ଠିକଣା ପ୍ରମାଣ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଅନ୍ୟ ଜାଗାରୁ ଆସୁଥିବା ସଦସ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ପୁରୁଣା କାର୍ଡର ଡିଲିସନ ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ ଲଗାନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ବିନା ସିଷ୍ଟମ ସେହି ନାମକୁ ଡୁପ୍ଲିକେଟ ବୋଲି ଯୋଡ଼ିବାକୁ ଦିଏ ନାହିଁ।
ସବମିଟ କରି ରସିଦ ନମ୍ବର ରଖନ୍ତୁ; ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ ସେହି ନମ୍ବରରେ ସ୍ଥିତି ଦେଖାଯାଏ।
ଫୁଡ ଇନସପେକ୍ଟର ଠିକଣାରେ ଯାଇ ପରିବାରକୁ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତି, ଏବଂ ନୂଆ କାର୍ଡ ପାଇଁ ବର୍ଗ — ଅନ୍ତ୍ୟୋଦୟ, ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ପରିବାର କିମ୍ବା APL — ଏହି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟରେ ସ୍ଥିର ହୁଏ।
ମଞ୍ଜୁର ହେବା ପରେ କାର୍ଡ ଡାଉନଲୋଡ କରନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ସେଥିରେ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ନାମ ଓ ଆଧାର ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ।
ନୂଆ ସଦସ୍ୟଙ୍କୁ ନ୍ୟାଯ୍ୟ ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଦୋକାନକୁ ନେଇ ePoS ମେସିନରେ ବାୟୋମେଟ୍ରିକ e-KYC କରାନ୍ତୁ। ଏହା ନହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପରିବାରର ଚାଉଳ ବଢ଼େ ନାହିଁ।

demoSteps: ପ୍ରଥମେ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ ଯେ ରାସନ କାର୍ଡରେ ଆପଣ ପରିବାର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଭାବେ ଲେଖାଯାଇଛନ୍ତି। ନହେଲେ ଆବେଦନ ଆଗରୁ ଆହାର ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ କାର୍ଡ ସୁଧାରନ୍ତୁ — ଯୋଜନା କାର୍ଡ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ଚାଲେ, ଘର ପ୍ରକୃତରେ କିଏ ଚଳାଏ ସେ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ନୁହେଁ।
ସେବା ସିନ୍ଧୁ ସେବା ପୋର୍ଟାଲ ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ, ଗୃହ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ମୀ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ ନମ୍ବର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। ପୋର୍ଟାଲ ନିଜେ ପରିବାର ବିବରଣୀ ଭରିଦିଏ।
OTP ଦେଇ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଆଧାର ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରନ୍ତୁ, ବିବାହିତ ହୋଇଥିଲେ ସ୍ୱାମୀଙ୍କ ଆଧାର ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ, ଏବଂ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ନିଜ ନାମରେ ଥିବା ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।
ସବମିଟ କରି ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବର ଲେଖି ରଖନ୍ତୁ। କୌଣସି ଫି ନାହିଁ; ଗ୍ରାମ ୱାନ, କର୍ଣ୍ଣାଟକ ୱାନ କିମ୍ବା ବାଙ୍ଗାଲୋର ୱାନ କେନ୍ଦ୍ର ମଧ୍ୟ ମାଗଣାରେ ଆବେଦନ କରିଦେବ।
ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ କିମ୍ବା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କରେ ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟର NPCI ସିଡିଂ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ। ଆଧାର ସହିତ ଲିଙ୍କ ଥିବା କିନ୍ତୁ NPCI-ସିଡେଡ ନଥିବା ଆକାଉଣ୍ଟରେ ଟଙ୍କା ପଠାଗଲେ ତାହା ବିଫଳ ହେବ।
ମଞ୍ଜୁର ହେବା ପରେ ପ୍ରତି ମାସରେ ଟ.2,000 ଜମା ହୁଏ। ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବର ଦେଇ ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ ମଞ୍ଜୁରି ଓ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ପେମେଣ୍ଟ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।
କୌଣସି ମାସ ଟଙ୍କା ନ ଆସିଲେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ସିଡିଂ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତା'ପରେ ଆବେଦନ ନମ୍ବର ନେଇ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଗ୍ରାମ ୱାନ କେନ୍ଦ୍ର କିମ୍ବା ତାଲୁକ ଅଫିସକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତୁ।

schemes.title: Kerala Construction Workers Welfare Board Membership (Nirmana Thozhilali Kshemanidhi)
schemes.department: Kerala Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour and Skills Department, Government of Kerala
schemes.brief: Membership for masons, carpenters, helpers, painters, electricians, plumbers and other building workers aged 18 to 59. Members pay Rs.50 a month and get a pension after 60, and help at childbirth and marriage, for children's education, medical treatment, disability and death. You join at the Board's district office with proof of age and of 90 days' construction work. The Board has about 20 lakh members but is short of money: in June 2026 the Labour Minister told the Assembly that pensions have been pending since June 2025.
schemes.benefit: Pension Rs.1,600 a month after 60, plus maternity, marriage, education, treatment and death aid
eligibility: Aged 18 to 59 and working in building or other construction work in Kerala
Worked at least 90 days in construction work in the last 12 months
Pay the Rs.50 monthly subscription to keep the membership active; a break can stop your benefits
Pension: 60 or older with at least 5 years of active membership
Maternity aid: women members with at least 1 year of membership, for up to two deliveries
After a member's or pensioner's death, the nominee or spouse can claim the death benefit or family pension
documents: Membership application form from the Board's district office
Age proof: birth certificate, school certificate or Aadhaar
Certificate of at least 90 days' construction work in the last 12 months, from your employer or contractor
आधार कार्ड की प्रति
Copy of a bank passbook in the worker's own name
Passport-size photos and your nominee's details
For each benefit later: the Board's claim form for it (Form 34 for pension, Form 38 for disability pension, Form 36 for death benefit) with the Welfare Fund ID card and passbook
schemes.submitAt: The district office of the Kerala Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (District Executive Officer) in your district. Collect the membership form there, attach the copies, pay the first subscription and take a receipt. Head office: Nirman Bhavan, Mettukada, Thycaud, Thiruvananthapuram.

demoSteps: Collect the membership form at the Board's district office in your district.
Fill it and attach the age proof, the 90-day work certificate, Aadhaar, bank passbook copy and photos.
Submit it at the district office with the first subscription and keep the receipt. If the District Executive Officer rejects it, you can appeal to the Board Secretary within 30 days.
You get a Welfare Fund ID card and passbook. Pay Rs.50 every month so the membership stays active.

For a benefit such as maternity, marriage or treatment aid, apply at the same office on the Board's form for it, with the ID card and passbook, soon after the event; after 90 days you must explain the delay.

At 60, with 5 years of active membership, apply for the pension on Form 34 with the ID card, passbook, bank passbook copy and Aadhaar. It is paid into your bank, but payments are running many months late now.

schemes.title: कारुण्य आरोग्य सुरक्षा पद्धति (KASP कार्ड)
schemes.department: State Health Agency Kerala, Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Kerala
schemes.brief: Kerala's free health cover, run together with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. About 42 lakh poorer families get treatment worth up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at about 180 government and 365 private empanelled hospitals. The KASP card is made at the KASP help desk of an empanelled hospital or at an Akshaya centre after an Aadhaar check. The new government plans to merge KASP into a bigger Oommen Chandy Health Insurance Scheme, but until that is notified KASP cards keep working as before.
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless, at empanelled hospitals
eligibility: Families that had an RSBY or CHIS health card in 2018-19, and families on the PM-JAY list (SECC 2011), including those who got the letter from the Prime Minister
About 42 lakh families, the poorest 40% of Kerala. Every member is covered, whatever the age or the size of the family
Illnesses you already have are covered from day one. Costs for 3 days before admission and 15 days after discharge are included
Other families cannot join now. New names are added only when the government announces it

A seriously ill patient from a poor family that is not in KASP can ask the same hospital desk about the Karunya Benevolent Fund: Rs.2 lakh for illnesses such as cancer and heart disease, Rs.3 lakh for kidney disease
documents: Aadhaar card of every family member who needs a card
ରାସନ କାର୍ଡ
OTP ପାଇଁ ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର
Old RSBY or CHIS card, or the letter from the Prime Minister, if you have one
At admission: the KASP card (or its number) and the patient's Aadhaar
schemes.submitAt: The KASP (PM-JAY) help desk at any empanelled government or private hospital, such as a medical college, district or taluk hospital, or any Akshaya e-Kendra. Take the Aadhaar card of every member who needs a card, the ration card and a mobile phone. There is no paper form: the staff search your family on the computer and check each member's Aadhaar.

demoFields.hint: Fingerprint on the machine. If it fails, an OTP to the Aadhaar-linked mobile or a face scan is used.

demoFields.hint: A number you keep with you. Messages about the card and hospital approvals come here.

demoSteps: Check if your family is covered: ask at an Akshaya centre or a hospital KASP desk, or call DISHA on 1056.
Go to the KASP desk of an empanelled hospital or an Akshaya centre with each member's Aadhaar, the ration card and your phone.
The staff find your family, check each member's Aadhaar by fingerprint or OTP, take a photo and print the KASP card.
When treatment is needed, go to an empanelled hospital and show the KASP card and Aadhaar at the KASP counter before admission.
The hospital takes approval from the State Health Agency. Medicines, tests, surgery, ICU, room and food in the package are free; do not pay cash for a covered treatment.
If the hospital refuses or asks you to pay, call DISHA 1056 or the State Health Agency before paying.
Not on the list but seriously ill and poor? Ask the same desk how to apply to the Karunya Benevolent Fund.
schemes.helpline: 1056 — DISHA health helpline (24x7); 0471-2960221 / 0471-4063121 — State Health Agency Kerala; 14555 — Ayushman Bharat national helpline

schemes.title: Social Security Pension (Kshema Pension / Sevana Pension)
schemes.department: Local Self Government Department and Finance Department, Government of Kerala, through grama panchayats, municipalities and corporations
schemes.brief: Kerala's monthly welfare pension, Rs.2,000 since November 2025, for poor elderly people, widows, persons with disabilities, unmarried women over 50 and old agricultural labourers. About 52 lakh people get it. Your grama panchayat, municipality or corporation takes the paper form, checks your case and must decide within 45 days. The money comes every month to your bank account, or a co-operative bank agent hands it over at your home. The new government has promised to raise it to Rs.3,000, but no date has been fixed yet.
schemes.benefit: Rs.2,000 a month
eligibility: Family income not above Rs.1 lakh a year, and not an income tax payer
Old age pension: 60 or above. Agricultural labourer pension: 60 or above, at least 10 years as a farm labourer and a member of the Agricultural Workers' Welfare Fund
Widow pension: widows who have not remarried, and women of 50 or more whose husband has been missing or has left them for over 7 years. Unmarried women's pension: unmarried women aged 50 or more
Disability pension: persons with 40% or more disability certified by a medical board

Not eligible: land over 2 acres (except ST families), a car over 1000 cc that is not a taxi, a concrete house over 2,000 sq ft with modern flooring, or a government or PSU service or family pension (ex-gratia or NPS pension up to Rs.4,000 is allowed)
Only one social security pension per person (except persons with disability), applied for in the local body where you live permanently
documents: Age proof: school certificate, birth certificate, church or mosque record, voter ID or Aadhaar
Income certificate from the Village Office
Certificate of permanent residence
Aadhaar card and voter ID card (copy of both sides)
Ration card (copy of the first page and the page with your name)
Bank passbook copy, if you want the pension in a bank
Widows: husband's death certificate. Disability pension: medical board disability certificate
EPF passbook, only if you get an EPF pension below Rs.4,000
schemes.submitAt: The front office of your grama panchayat, municipality or corporation, addressed to the Secretary. The linked form is for the old age pension; the forms for widow, disability, unmarried women and agricultural labourer pensions are on welfarepension.lsgkerala.gov.in under Application Forms. Fill the form, paste a passport photo taken within the last 6 months, sign it, attach self-attested copies of the documents and take a receipt.

demoFields.label: Gender and category
